title.zh: 卷一百九十六 志第一百四十九 兵十
title.raw: 卷一百九十六 志第一百四十九 兵十 Volume 196 Treatises 149: Military 10

sentences.zh: 遷補之制

translations.literal: The system of promotion and filling vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on Promotion and Appointment

sentences.zh: 自殿前、侍衛馬步軍校，每遇大禮後，各以次遷，謂之「轉員」。

translations.literal: As for officers of the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot armies, after each grand ceremony they each advance in order; this is called "zhuanyuan" (rotation of ranks).
translations.idiomatic: Among officers of the Palace Front Command and the Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot forces, after every major state ceremony each man advanced in seniority order in what was termed a "rank rotation."

sentences.zh: 轉員至軍都指揮使，又遷則遙領刺史，又遷為廂都指揮使，遙領團練使。

translations.literal: Upon rotating to army commander-in-chief, further promotion meant a titular appointment as prefect; further still, appointment as division commander with titular regimental training commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: After rotating up to army commander, the next step was a titular prefectship; beyond that one became a division commander while holding a titular regimental training commission.

sentences.zh: 員溢，即從上罷軍職，為正團練使、刺史之本任，或有他州總管、鈐轄。

translations.literal: When posts overflowed, they were then relieved from above of military office and given substantive appointments as regimental training commissioner or prefect in their proper posts, or sometimes as circuit commander or supervisory commissioner in another prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the roster was overfilled, men were released from active command and assigned substantive posts as regimental training commissioners or prefects, or occasionally as circuit commanders or supervisory commissioners elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 其老疾若過失者，為御前忠佐馬軍都軍頭、副都軍頭，隸軍頭司。

translations.literal: Those who were aged, ill, or at fault were made chief or deputy chief of the Imperial Front Loyal Assistants Horse Army, subordinate to the Army Chiefs Office.
translations.idiomatic: Men who were old, infirm, or guilty of misconduct were placed as chief or deputy chief of the Imperial Front Loyal Assistants Horse Detachment under the Army Chiefs Office.

sentences.zh: 其黜，則為外州馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Those demoted were made horse-and-foot army commanders of outer prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Those removed from the capital ranks were posted as horse-and-foot commanders in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 凡軍主闕，以軍都指揮使遞遷；

translations.literal: Whenever an army commander's post was vacant, army commanders-in-chief advanced in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever an army commander's billet fell vacant, the post was filled by successive promotion from among army commanders-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 餘闕，以諸軍都虞候、指揮使、副指揮使、行首、軍使、副行首、副兵馬使、十將遞遷。

translations.literal: Other vacancies were filled by successive promotion from army adjutants, company commanders, deputy company commanders, platoon leaders, battalion officers, deputy platoon leaders, deputy horse-and-arms officers, and squad sergeants.
translations.idiomatic: All other openings were filled in turn from the ranks of army adjutants, company commanders, deputy commanders, platoon leaders, battalion officers, deputy platoon leaders, deputy horse-and-arms officers, and squad sergeants.

sentences.zh: 凡將校，一軍營止補十人，其廂都指揮使、軍都指揮使、都虞候、指揮使，營主其一，即闕其三。

translations.literal: For all officers, only ten men per army camp were appointed; of division commanders, army commanders-in-chief, adjutants, and company commanders, if one camp supplied one man, three posts would remain vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Only ten officers per army camp could be appointed at a time; because each camp might contribute just one man toward the four senior grades of division commander, army commander, adjutant, and company commander, three of those posts would typically go unfilled.

sentences.zh: 殿前左右班都虞候遙領刺史，即與捧日軍都指揮使通，以次遷捧日、龍衛廂都指揮使，仍遙領團練使。

translations.literal: Left and right platoon adjutants of the Palace Front, holding titular prefectships, were then linked with the Sun-Bearing Army commander-in-chief and advanced in order to division command of the Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard units, still holding titular regimental training commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front left- and right-platoon adjutants who held titular prefectships were then paired with the Sun-Bearing Army commander and promoted in sequence to division command of the Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard corps, still on a titular regimental training commission.

sentences.zh: 若員溢，即為正刺史補外，他如諸軍例遞遷。

translations.literal: If posts overflowed, they were given substantive prefectships and assigned outside; others followed the usual successive promotion of the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: When the roster was full they received substantive prefectships and were posted abroad; all others advanced by the usual rotation rules of their corps.

sentences.zh: 凡列校轉補，有司先閱走躍、上下馬；

translations.literal: For all company-grade officers seeking promotion, the authorities first inspected running and leaping and mounting and dismounting.
translations.idiomatic: Before any company-grade officer could be promoted, the responsible office first tested his running and leaping and his skill at mounting and dismounting.

sentences.zh: 次出指二十步，掩一目試之，左右各五占數為見物。

translations.literal: Next they extended a finger twenty paces away and tested with one eye covered; five counts on the left and five on the right counted as seeing the object.
translations.idiomatic: Next an examiner held up a finger twenty paces off while the candidate covered one eye; he had to identify it within five counts on each side to pass the vision test.

sentences.zh: 武藝，弓射五斗，弩廣一石五斗，槍刀手稍練。

translations.literal: In martial skill: bow shooting at five dou draw, crossbow at one shi five dou span, and spearmen and swordsmen somewhat practiced.
translations.idiomatic: In arms he had to draw a bow of five dou, span a crossbow of one shi five dou, and show reasonable skill with spear or blade.

sentences.zh: 負罪不至徒，年未高，或雖年高而無疾、精力不耗者，並取之。

translations.literal: Those guilty of offenses not reaching penal servitude, not yet advanced in years, or though advanced in years without illness and without wasted vigor—all were accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Men were accepted if their offenses did not rise to penal servitude, if they were not yet elderly, or if though older they were free of illness and still vigorous.

sentences.zh: 凡諸軍轉員後，取殿前指揮使長入祗候填行門，取東西班長入祗候、殿侍、諸班直充諸班押班、諸軍將校者，皆親閱。

translations.literal: After the armies' rank rotation, those taken from Palace Front company commanders to fill Inner Attendance and Gate Corps posts, and from Eastern and Western Platoon commanders to fill Inner Attendance, Palace Attendants, and various duty platoons as platoon leads and army officers—all were personally inspected.
translations.idiomatic: After each army rotation, the emperor personally inspected every man selected—from Palace Front company commanders posted to Inner Attendance and the Gate Corps, and from Eastern and Western platoon commanders assigned to Inner Attendance, palace service, duty platoons, and field commands.

sentences.zh: 前一日，命入內都知或押班一人、勾當御藥院內侍一人，同軍頭引見司較定弓弩鬪力，標誌之。

translations.literal: On the previous day he ordered one Inner Palace director or platoon lead and one eunuch managing the Imperial Pharmacy, together with the Army Chiefs Presentation Office, to calibrate bow and crossbow draw weights and mark them.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, he directed an Inner Palace director or platoon lead and a eunuch of the Imperial Pharmacy, together with the Army Chiefs Presentation Office, to fix and mark each candidate's bow and crossbow draw weights.

sentences.zh: 凡弓弩藝等者，人占其一。

translations.literal: For all bow and crossbow skill grades, each man was assigned one.
translations.idiomatic: Each candidate was assigned to one grade of bow or crossbow skill.

sentences.zh: 至日，引見，弓弩列置殿前，命取一以射。

translations.literal: On the day, they were presented; bows and crossbows were arrayed before the hall, and he ordered one to be taken and shot.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of presentation, bows and crossbows were lined up before the throne and each man was told to take one and shoot.

sentences.zh: 軍頭引見司專視喝箭以奏。

translations.literal: The Army Chiefs Presentation Office alone watched the called shot and reported.
translations.idiomatic: The Army Chiefs Presentation Office alone monitored the called score and reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 如喝失當，即奏改正。

translations.literal: If the call was improper, they immediately reported a correction.
translations.idiomatic: If the announced score was wrong, they at once reported a correction.

sentences.zh: 入內都知或押班同勾當御藥院內侍殿上察視，如引見司不覺舉，亦奏改正。

translations.literal: The Inner Palace director or platoon lead together with the Imperial Pharmacy eunuch observed from the hall; if the Presentation Office failed to notice and report, they too reported corrections.
translations.idiomatic: An Inner Palace director or platoon lead and the Imperial Pharmacy eunuch watched from the dais; if the Presentation Office missed an error, they too reported it for correction.

sentences.zh: 槍刀手竭勝負，若喝不以實，並引見司失覺舉，並劾其罪。

translations.literal: Spearmen and swordsmen strove to the end for victory or defeat; if the call was not truthful, or if the Presentation Office failed to notice and report, all were impeached for their offense.
translations.idiomatic: Spear and blade men fought to a finish; anyone who called the result falsely, or whom the Presentation Office failed to catch, was charged with an offense.

sentences.zh: 太平興國九年，上詣崇政殿轉改諸軍將校，自軍都指揮使以下、員僚以上，皆按名籍驗勞績而陞陟之，凡數日而畢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Taiping Xingguo, the emperor went to Chongzheng Hall to rotate and change officers of the various armies; from army commanders-in-chief down and staff officers up, all were promoted or demoted according to name registers and verified merit records, finishing in several days.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 9 the emperor went to Chongzheng Hall to rotate officers of every corps; from army commanders down through the staff grades, each man's register and service record were checked before promotion or demotion, and the work took several days.

sentences.zh: 內外感悅。

translations.literal: Inside and outside, all were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Court and camp alike were gratified.

sentences.zh: 乃謂宰臣等曰：「朕遷轉軍員，先取其循謹能御下者，武勇次之。

translations.literal: He then said to the chief ministers and others: "When I rotate military personnel, I first take those who are dutiful and restrained and able to command subordinates; martial valor comes second."
translations.idiomatic: He then told his chief ministers: "When I rotate army officers, I look first for men who are disciplined and can control their troops; raw courage comes second."

sentences.zh: 若不自謹飭，則其下不畏憚，雖有一夫之勇，亦何所用！」

translations.literal: "If one does not restrain oneself, then subordinates will not fear and respect him; though he have the courage of a single man, of what use is it!"
translations.idiomatic: "If a man cannot keep himself in order, his men will not fear him—and what good is individual bravery then?"

sentences.zh: 咸平三年五月，上御便殿遷補軍職，凡十一日而畢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Xianping, the emperor attended the side hall to promote and fill military posts; it was completed in eleven days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Xianping 3 the emperor held promotion sessions in the side hall and finished the roster in eleven days.

sentences.zh: 自神衛右第二軍都指揮使、恩州刺史周訓而下，遞遷者千三十一人。

translations.literal: From Zhou Xun, army commander of the second right Divine Guard Army and titular prefect of Enzhou, downward, those who advanced in succession numbered 1,031.
translations.idiomatic: Starting with Zhou Xun, commander of the second right Divine Guard Army and titular prefect of Enzhou, 1,031 men were advanced in succession.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月，帝謂呂蒙正曰：「選眾求才，誠非易事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year, the emperor said to Lü Mengzheng: "Choosing from the multitude to seek talent is truly not an easy matter."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 4 the emperor said to Lü Mengzheng: "Picking talent from a large pool is no easy task."

sentences.zh: 朕常孜孜詢訪，冀有所得。

translations.literal: I constantly inquire and investigate diligently, hoping to gain something.
translations.idiomatic: I keep searching diligently in the hope of finding someone worthwhile.

sentences.zh: 向求於軍校中，超擢八九人，委以方任，其間王能、魏能頗甚宣力，陳興、張禹珪亦有能名。

translations.literal: Recently, seeking among army officers, I promoted eight or nine men exceptionally and entrusted them with regional responsibilities; among them Wang Neng and Wei Neng have shown considerable merit in service, and Chen Xing and Zhang Yugui also have reputations for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Not long ago I picked eight or nine officers from the ranks for exceptional promotion and gave them regional commands. Wang Neng and Wei Neng have served notably well, and Chen Xing and Zhang Yugui also enjoy good reputations.

sentences.zh: 」蒙正等曰：「才難求備。

translations.literal: " Mengzheng and others said: "Talent is hard to obtain in full measure."
translations.idiomatic: " Lü Mengzheng and the others replied: "No one is talented in every way."

sentences.zh: 今拔十得五，有以見陛下知臣之明也。」

translations.literal: Now, selecting ten and getting five, this shows Your Majesty's perspicacity in knowing men."
translations.idiomatic: If you pick ten and five prove sound, that already shows how well Your Majesty judges men."

sentences.zh: 五年，帝謂知樞密院周瑩曰：「國朝之制，軍員有闕，但權領之，三歲一遷補。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the emperor said to Zhou Ying, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs: "Our dynasty's system is that when military posts are vacant, men only hold them provisionally; every three years there is a promotion and filling round."
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the emperor told Zhou Ying, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs: "Under our system, vacant army billets are only held in an acting capacity until the triennial promotion round."

sentences.zh: 未及期以功而授，止奉朝請而已。

translations.literal: Before the term, if appointed for merit, they only attended court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: If a man was given a post early for merit before the cycle, he merely attended court and drew stipend.

sentences.zh: 今闕員處則乏人部轄。

translations.literal: Now where posts are vacant there is a lack of men to command and oversee.
translations.idiomatic: But wherever billets stand empty, there is no one to command the troops.

sentences.zh: 須當例與轉補。

translations.literal: We must give routine promotion and filling.
translations.idiomatic: We must hold a regular promotion round to fill them."

sentences.zh: 」於是召瑩等至便殿，按軍籍次補，其屯戍於外及軍額在下素不該恩例，亦溥及之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he summoned Ying and others to the side hall and, according to army registers, filled posts in order; those garrisoned outside and army rolls in lower grades that normally did not qualify for favor were also broadly included.
translations.idiomatic: He then summoned Zhou Ying and the others to the side hall and filled posts in register order. Men on outside garrison duty and lower-grade units that normally missed such favors were included as well.

sentences.zh: 凡再旬方畢。

translations.literal: In all it took twenty days to finish.
translations.idiomatic: The whole process took twenty days.

sentences.zh: 景德二年四月，帝曰：「殿前諸班、侍衛馬步諸軍及軍頭司諸軍員，因衰病或以他事出補外職，率皆臨事奏裁，殊無定制，可條其所入職名類例以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Jingde, the emperor said: "Palace Front platoons, Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot armies, and Army Chiefs Office personnel who leave for outside posts due to infirmity or other matters—all are decided ad hoc by memorial for imperial decision, with no fixed regulation. Draw up the titles and categories of posts they enter and report."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Jingde 2 the emperor said: "When men of the Palace Front platoons, Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot forces, or the Army Chiefs Office leave the capital for outside posts because of age, illness, or other reasons, each case is decided ad hoc. Draw up a fixed list of the outside titles they receive and report it."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「近累有諸處立功指揮使，未可別加遷擢，皆特補本軍都虞候。

translations.literal: He also said: "Recently there have repeatedly been company commanders who distinguished themselves in various places; they should not receive separate exceptional promotion—all are specially appointed army adjutants of their own corps."
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Company commanders who have lately won merit in the field should not receive special jumps in rank; appoint them all as army adjutants of their own unit."

sentences.zh: 舊無此職名，蓋權宜加置，若後有闕，不須復補。

translations.literal: This post title did not exist before; it was added as an expedient. If vacancies arise later, they need not be filled again.
translations.idiomatic: That title did not exist before; it is an expedient. Do not refill it when it falls vacant again."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「內外諸軍所闕小校，儻以名次遷補，或慮不能盡得武幹之士，自今並令閱試武藝，選擢為之。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Junior officers vacant in inner and outer armies—if filled by seniority alone, one fears not all martially capable men will be obtained. From now on, all are to be tested in martial skill and selected and promoted accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Vacant junior posts in the capital and provincial armies cannot all be filled by seniority alone if we want capable fighters. From now on, test martial skill and promote on merit."

sentences.zh: 大中祥符四年七月，詔曰：「自來轉補軍員，皆是議定降宣命訖，方引見轉補。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, an edict said: "Hitherto, when rotating and filling military personnel, all were decided by deliberation and imperial order issued before presentation and rotation."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Dazhong Xiangfu 4 an edict declared: "Until now, army promotions were decided in advance and the imperial order issued before men were presented at court."

sentences.zh: 其間有老病不任職者，臨時易之，無由整齊。

translations.literal: Among them were those old or ill and unfit for office, replaced at the last moment, with no way to keep things orderly.
translations.idiomatic: Men who proved too old or ill for duty were swapped at the last minute, so the roster could never be kept in order.

sentences.zh: 經汾陰大禮，應殿前馬步軍諸班諸軍員，並分作甲次於崇政殿逐人唱名引見，朕自視之。

translations.literal: After the great Fenyin ceremony, all Palace Front horse and foot army platoons and personnel were divided into groups by rotation order at Chongzheng Hall, called by name one by one and presented; I myself inspected them.
translations.idiomatic: After the great Fenyin rites, every Palace Front horse and foot platoon and officer was grouped by rotation batch at Chongzheng Hall, called forward by name, and inspected by me in person.

sentences.zh: 有不任職者，當於不係禁軍處優與安排，免轉員之際，旋議改易。

translations.literal: Those unfit for office should be favorably placed in non-Palace Guard posts, avoiding last-minute changes during rank rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone unfit for duty should be given a favorable post outside the Palace Guard now, so we need not reshuffle him during the rotation."

sentences.zh: 」八月，詔：「殿前、侍衛馬軍步軍司所管內外禁軍軍員，自來補轉，體例不一，未得均平。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict said: "Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands' inner and outer Palace Guard personnel—hitherto promotion and rotation practices have not been uniform and have not been equitable."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict said: "Promotion rules for Palace Guard personnel under the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands have never been uniform or fair."

sentences.zh: 朕夙夜思之。

translations.literal: I have pondered this day and night.
translations.idiomatic: I have thought about this constantly.

sentences.zh: 今來該汾陰轉員，可立定久遠規制。

translations.literal: Now that the Fenyin rank rotation is due, permanent regulations may be established.
translations.idiomatic: With the Fenyin rotation at hand, we can now set lasting rules.

sentences.zh: 其馬軍、步軍，自指揮使以下，各別轉補，皆令自下而陞。

translations.literal: For horse and foot armies, from company commander down, each is to be rotated and filled separately, all rising from below.
translations.idiomatic: Horse and foot units alike shall promote from company commander down, each corps on its own ladder, always rising from the bottom up.

sentences.zh: 仍將殿前、侍衛馬軍步軍司所轄軍分，各袞同轉補。

translations.literal: Moreover, the army units under the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands are each to be interwoven for joint rotation and filling.
translations.idiomatic: Units under the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard commands shall also rotate together on interleaved schedules.

sentences.zh: 如馬軍軍員自近下補至拱聖，即雙取之，以分補捧日、龍衛，其近下軍分有闕，即卻自捧日、龍衛雙取，陞一員資補填。

translations.literal: For example, when horse army personnel are filled from the lowest ranks up to Gongsheng, two are taken at once to fill Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard separately; if lower units have vacancies, two are taken back from Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard, advanced one grade, and used to fill.
translations.idiomatic: When horse troops rise from the lowest units to Gongsheng, take two men at once and split them between Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard; if a lower unit has a vacancy, take two back from Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard, promote each one grade, and fill the gap.

sentences.zh: 其步軍有闕，填補並準此。

translations.literal: Where foot armies have vacancies, filling follows the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Foot units follow the same rule for vacancies."

sentences.zh: 」又詔：「所議改更轉補軍員職名，恐諸軍未喻，可降宣命云：殿前、侍衛馬步軍司自來多是龍衛更轉入捧日，並神衛更入天武之類，是致難得出職，久成沉滯。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "The revised titles for rotating military personnel may not be understood by the armies; an imperial order may be issued stating: Hitherto the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands mostly rotated Dragon Guard into Sun-Bearing and Divine Guard into Heavenly Martial, causing difficulty in leaving office and long stagnation."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict explained the change for the troops: "In the past Dragon Guard men had to rotate into Sun-Bearing and Divine Guard into Heavenly Martial, which blocked promotion and left many men stuck for years."

sentences.zh: 今來轉員，出自朕意，並各與分兩頭遷改，其龍衛更不入捧日，並神衛更不入天武。

translations.literal: This rank rotation, proceeding from my intent, gives each a split two-track transfer: Dragon Guard no longer enters Sun-Bearing, and Divine Guard no longer enters Heavenly Martial.
translations.idiomatic: This rotation is by my design: each corps now has two promotion tracks. Dragon Guard no longer feeds Sun-Bearing, and Divine Guard no longer feeds Heavenly Martial.

sentences.zh: 其捧日、龍衛闕，於拱聖內隔間取人，分頭充填。

translations.literal: Vacancies in Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard are filled by taking men from Gongsheng at intervals and assigning them separately.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies in Sun-Bearing and Dragon Guard are filled by taking men from Gongsheng at intervals and splitting them between the two corps.

sentences.zh: 其拱聖闕，即將驍騎、雲騎分頭轉入。

translations.literal: Gongsheng vacancies are filled by rotating in from Valiant Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry separately.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsheng vacancies are filled from Valiant Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry on separate tracks.

sentences.zh: 其天武、神衛闕，於神勇內隔間取人，分頭充填。

translations.literal: Heavenly Martial and Divine Guard vacancies are filled by taking men from Divine Valor at intervals and assigning them separately.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Martial and Divine Guard vacancies are filled from Divine Valor at intervals on separate tracks.

sentences.zh: 其神勇闕，即將宣武充填。

translations.literal: Divine Valor vacancies are filled from Martial Display.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Valor vacancies are filled from Martial Display.

sentences.zh: 其宣武闕，取殿前、步軍司虎翼充填。

translations.literal: Martial Display vacancies are filled from Tiger Wing units of the Palace Front and Foot Army commands.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Display vacancies are filled from Tiger Wing units under the Palace Front and Foot Army commands.

sentences.zh: 已上如取盡指定軍員，即轉已次軍員充填。

translations.literal: If the designated army personnel above are exhausted, then personnel from the next lower army are rotated to fill.
translations.idiomatic: If the designated units are exhausted, take men from the next lower unit in the chain.

sentences.zh: 所有寧朔軍分次第請受並轉員出入，今後並特與依驍勝體例施行。」

translations.literal: All Ningshuo army units' order of pay grades and rank rotation in and out shall henceforth specially follow the Valiant Victory model."
translations.idiomatic: All Ningshuo units shall henceforth follow the Valiant Victory model for pay grades and rotation in and out of the capital."

sentences.zh: 六年十月，詔：「諸班直並馬步軍事軍員，其諸班、捧日、龍衛、天武、神衛五頭下出人外，其御龍諸直作一處轉；

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year, an edict said: "Duty platoons and horse and foot army staff officers—except for the five top units of platoons, Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Heavenly Martial, and Divine Guard going outside, Imperial Dragon duty platoons rotate as one group;"
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 6 an edict ordered: "Duty platoons and horse and foot staff rotate as follows: apart from the five elite corps—duty platoons, Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Heavenly Martial, and Divine Guard—when men leave the capital, Imperial Dragon platoons rotate as one pool;"

sentences.zh: 員僚直、拱聖、驍騎、雲騎、驍勝、武騎、寧朔、神騎已上軍額軍員，作一處挨排遞遷；

translations.literal: staff duty platoons, Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, Valiant Victory, Martial Cavalry, Ningshuo, Divine Cavalry and above army rolls rotate in one queue by succession;
translations.idiomatic: staff duty platoons, Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, Valiant Victory, Martial Cavalry, Ningshuo, and Divine Cavalry form one succession queue;

sentences.zh: 水軍神勇、宣武，殿前司虎翼、衛聖，步軍司虎翼、奉節、廣勇、神射已上軍額軍員，作一處挨排轉補；

translations.literal: naval Divine Valor and Martial Display, Palace Front Tiger Wing and Guard Sacred, Foot Army Tiger Wing, Loyal Festival, Broad Valor, Divine Shot and above army rolls rotate and fill in one queue;
translations.idiomatic: naval Divine Valor and Martial Display, Palace Front Tiger Wing and Guard Sacred, Foot Army Tiger Wing, Loyal Festival, Broad Valor, and Divine Shot form a second queue for rotation;

sentences.zh: 事內殿前指揮使押班至都知只本班轉，其神衛、廣勇、神射已下至軍使、都頭，即逐指揮內遞遷。

translations.literal: within these, Palace Front company commander platoon leads through directors rotate only within their own platoons; from Divine Guard, Broad Valor, Divine Shot down to battalion officer and squad chief, they advance within each company.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front platoon leads through directors rotate within their own platoons; from Divine Guard, Broad Valor, and Divine Shot down to battalion officer and squad chief, men advance within their own company.

sentences.zh: 內有年及六十已下者並勾押赴闕，令殿前司看驗聞奏，當議相度安排。

translations.literal: Those within who have reached sixty years or below are all to be summoned to court; the Palace Front Command is to examine and report, and arrangements are to be deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Men aged sixty or under in these pools are to be brought to court for the Palace Front Command to inspect and report on, so that their assignments may be decided.

sentences.zh: 所有副兵馬使、副都頭員闕，仍取捧日、龍衛、神勇十將充填，餘並從之。

translations.literal: All vacancies for deputy horse-and-arms officers and deputy squad chiefs are still to be filled from squad sergeants of Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, and Divine Valor; the rest follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies for deputy horse-and-arms officers and deputy squad chiefs are still to be filled from squad sergeants of Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, and Divine Valor; the remainder of the edict stands.

sentences.zh: 內神衛水軍第一指揮，令立充神衛水軍指揮；

translations.literal: within these, the first company of Divine Guard naval forces is ordered established as the Divine Guard naval command;
translations.idiomatic: The first company of Divine Guard naval forces is to be established as the Divine Guard naval command;

sentences.zh: 殿前司上虎翼第二、步軍司上虎翼第一，並立充虎翼水軍指揮，依舊係逐司管押。

translations.literal: Palace Front upper Tiger Wing second and Foot Army upper Tiger Wing first are both established as Tiger Wing naval commands, still under each command's supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front upper Tiger Wing second company and Foot Army upper Tiger Wing first company are both established as Tiger Wing naval commands under their respective bureaus.

sentences.zh: 其神衛水軍見管軍員，先自奉節補入，多不會舟楫，並一齊轉上外，卻將虎翼水軍兩指揮會水軍員與神衛水軍共三指揮一處袞轉。

translations.literal: The Divine Guard naval personnel now under command, earlier filled from Loyal Festival, mostly did not know boats; all are rotated outside together, while the two Tiger Wing naval commands' skilled sailors and Divine Guard naval forces—three commands in all—rotate together in one pool.
translations.idiomatic: Present Divine Guard naval men, originally drawn from Loyal Festival, mostly cannot handle boats; transfer them all outside, then merge the two Tiger Wing naval commands' skilled sailors with Divine Guard naval forces into one three-command rotation pool.

sentences.zh: 如轉至神衛水軍指揮使，除年老病患依例出職安排外，更不轉上。」

translations.literal: If one rotates to Divine Guard naval company commander, except for the aged and ill who leave office by regulation, no further upward rotation."
translations.idiomatic: Once a man reaches Divine Guard naval company commander, he rotates no higher except when age or illness requires a post outside the capital, as usual."

sentences.zh: 天聖六年，將轉員，樞密院奏：「諸軍將校有因循不敢戢士者，請諭殿前、馬步軍司密以名聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiansheng, as rank rotation approached, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "Among army officers there are those who are lax and dare not restrain soldiers; please instruct the Palace Front and horse and foot commands to report names secretly."
translations.idiomatic: In Tiansheng 6, as the rotation approached, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Some officers are slack and fail to discipline their men. Please have the Palace Front and horse and foot commands report their names in confidence."

sentences.zh: 」八年，詔殿前、侍衛司同定內外諸軍排立資次。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict ordered the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard commands jointly to fix the seniority order of inner and outer armies.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 an edict ordered the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard commands to fix the seniority ranking of all capital and provincial units.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年，詔緣邊就糧兵有員闕，奏以舊人次遷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyou, an edict said that when frontier grain-paid troops had vacancies, memorials were to advance veterans in order.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyou 2 an edict ordered that vacancies in frontier grain-paid units be filled by advancing veterans in seniority order.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，詔三品就糧將校半以次遷，半遣自京師。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, an edict said that third-grade grain-paid officers were half to advance by seniority and half to be dispatched from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangding 1 an edict ordered that third-grade grain-paid officers fill half their vacancies by local seniority and half from the capital.

sentences.zh: 又詔陝西土兵校長遣自京師，情不諳達，自今悉就本路通補。

translations.literal: Another edict said that dispatching Shaanxi local militia squad leaders from the capital was unsuitable because they were unfamiliar with conditions; from now on all are to be filled through the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict noted that sending squad leaders for Shaanxi local militia from the capital left them ignorant of local conditions; henceforth fill those posts within the circuit.

sentences.zh: 慶曆四年，詔捧日、天武選退將校超三資，餘超二資，悉補外職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qingli, an edict said that selected retired officers of Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial advanced three grades, others two grades, all filling outside posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 4 an edict ordered that retired officers selected from Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial advance three grades and all others two, with all assigned to posts outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 五年，真定府、定州路都總管司奏：「奉詔閱教軍士，選補階級，弓射九斗至一石，距堋七十步至百步，射最親者為第一等。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Zhending and Dingzhou circuit command memorialized: "Obeying the edict to review and train soldiers and select ranks: bow shooting from nine to ten dou, distance from butt seventy to one hundred paces; closest hits rank first class."
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the Zhending and Dingzhou circuit command reported: "Under the edict to inspect troops and fill ranks, bows of nine to ten dou are shot from seventy to one hundred paces at the butt; the closest hits rank first class."

sentences.zh: 其閱教時，弓不必引滿，力競即發，務在必中。

translations.literal: At review and training, the bow need not be drawn full; compete in strength and release at once, striving to hit without fail.
translations.idiomatic: At inspection the bow need not be fully drawn; the archer competes for speed and must hit the target.

sentences.zh: 伏緣舊例軍中揀節級，以挽強引滿為勝。

translations.literal: We submit that by old regulation in the army, squad leaders were chosen by drawing the strong bow to the full.
translations.idiomatic: We note that under the old rule squad leaders were chosen by who could draw the heaviest bow to the full.

sentences.zh: 今一旦取射親者為第一等，其弓力止九斗、一石，箭留三兩指，而退素習挽強引滿之士，於理未便。

translations.literal: Now suddenly taking closest shooters as first class—with bow strength only nine or ten dou and arrows leaving two or three fingers undrawn—and setting aside men long practiced in drawing strong bows full is not reasonable.
translations.idiomatic: To rank closest hits first—with bows of only nine or ten dou and arrows not fully drawn—and pass over men trained to draw heavy bows full seems unfair.

sentences.zh: 」詔諸軍選節級用舊例，遇閱教即如近製。

translations.literal: An edict said: "All armies selecting squad leaders use the old rule; when review and training occur, follow the recent regulation."
translations.idiomatic: The court replied: "Choose squad leaders by the old rule in general; at formal inspections follow the new standard."

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年，詔：諸路就糧兵闕將校，須轉補滿三年聽遷。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangyou, an edict said: "Where grain-paid troops in the circuits lack officers, they must complete three years after promotion and filling before transfer is permitted."
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 1 an edict ordered that officers appointed to fill vacancies in circuit grain-paid units must serve three years before transfer.

sentences.zh: 又詔：將帥麾下兵，非有戰功，毋得請遷隸上軍。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Soldiers under generals, unless they have battle merit, may not request transfer to elite armies."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict forbade soldiers under field commanders from requesting transfer to elite units unless they had won merit in battle.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐二年，詔：京東教閱本城、騎射、威邊、威勇、壯武，自初募置，即給鼓旗閱教以代禁軍，如有員闕，聽遞遷至副指揮使止，轉補後滿三歲，闕三分已上即舉行。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiayou, an edict said: "Jingdong review units of Capital Garrison, Mounted Archers, Border Might, Valiant Might, and Strong Martial—from initial recruitment they receive drums and banners for review and training in place of Palace Guard; if vacancies arise, succession up to deputy company commander is permitted; after three years from rotation and filling, if vacancies exceed one-third, the round is held."
translations.idiomatic: In Jiayou 2 an edict ordered that Jingdong review units—Capital Garrison, Mounted Archers, Border Might, Valiant Might, and Strong Martial—trained from recruitment with drums and banners as Palace Guard substitutes may promote internally only to deputy company commander; after three years, if more than a third of posts are vacant, hold a promotion round.

sentences.zh: 其指揮使闕，即步軍司補之。

translations.literal: Company commander vacancies are filled by the Foot Army Command.
translations.idiomatic: Company commander vacancies are filled by the Foot Army Command.

sentences.zh: 至和三年，詔親從官入殿滿八年者補節級，從樞密院之請也。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhihe, an edict said that personal attendants who had entered the hall eight full years were appointed squad leaders, following the Bureau of Military Affairs' request.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 3, at the Bureau of Military Affairs' request, an edict ordered that personal attendants who had served in the hall eight years be appointed squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 治平元年，遷諸班直長行洎禁軍副兵馬使已上有材武者，得七十人，帝臨軒親閱。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiping, those promoted included duty platoon senior attendants and Palace Guard deputy horse-and-arms officers and above who had martial talent—seventy men in all—and the emperor personally inspected them at the hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiping 1 seventy men of talent were selected from duty platoon senior attendants and Palace Guard deputy horse-and-arms officers and above, and the emperor inspected them personally at the hall.

sentences.zh: 喻天武右第三軍都指揮使王秀曰：「爾武藝雖不中格，而有戰功，且能恪守法度，其以爾為正刺史，務勤乃職，無負朕之委寄也。

translations.literal: He told Wang Xiu, army commander of Heavenly Martial right third army: "Your martial skill though not meeting standard, you have battle merit and can strictly observe regulations; you are made substantive prefect—diligently perform your duties and do not betray my trust."
translations.idiomatic: He told Wang Xiu, commander of Heavenly Martial right third army: "Your martial skill falls short of the standard, but you have battle merit and keep discipline. I appoint you substantive prefect. Serve diligently and do not betray my trust."

sentences.zh: 」又喻散直都虞候胡從、內殿直副都知張思曰：「爾能勤以持身，忠以事上，治軍又皆整肅，其以從為內園使，思為崇儀副使。

translations.literal: He also told Hu Cong, adjutant of Scattered Duty, and Zhang Si, deputy director of Inner Hall Direct Duty: "You can be diligent in self-restraint and loyal in serving superiors, and in commanding troops all are orderly; Cong is made Inner Garden Commissioner, Si Vice Commissioner of Honored Rites."
translations.idiomatic: He also told Hu Cong, adjutant of Scattered Duty, and Zhang Si, deputy director of Inner Hall Direct Duty: "You are diligent and loyal, and your commands are well disciplined. Cong is appointed Inner Garden Commissioner; Si, Vice Commissioner of Honored Rites."

sentences.zh: 」自餘擢遷有差。

translations.literal: The rest received promotions in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The others were promoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔：「廣南教閱忠敢、澄海，一營者即本營遞遷，兩營已上者，營三百人補五人，二百人至三百人補三人，二百人以下補二人，百人以下補一人，止於副指揮使。

translations.literal: In the second year, an edict said: "Guangnan review units Loyal Valor and Clear Sea—a single camp rotates within its own camp; for two camps or more, a camp of three hundred men fills five posts, two hundred to three hundred fills three, under two hundred fills two, under one hundred fills one, stopping at deputy company commander."
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 an edict ordered that for Guangnan review units Loyal Valor and Clear Sea, a single camp promotes internally; for two or more camps, appoint five men per camp of three hundred, three for camps of two to three hundred, two below two hundred, and one below one hundred, up to deputy company commander only.

sentences.zh: 凡遞遷滿三歲，五階闕二、三階闕一即補。

translations.literal: After three years of successive promotion, if five grades lack two or three grades lack one, filling is conducted.
translations.idiomatic: After three years, if two of five grades are vacant or one of three, hold a filling round.

sentences.zh: 」四年，詔：「自今一營及二百五十人已上置校十人，闕三人即補。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict said: "From now on, for one camp and 250 men or more, ten officers are established; when three are vacant, filling is conducted."
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict ordered that camps of 250 men or more have ten officers; when three posts are vacant, fill them.

sentences.zh: 二百五十人已下置校七人，闕二人即補。

translations.literal: Under 250 men, seven officers are established; when two are vacant, filling is conducted.
translations.idiomatic: Camps under 250 men have seven officers; when two are vacant, fill them.

sentences.zh: 京師非轉員並諸道就糧並準此令。」

translations.literal: In the capital outside rank rotation and grain-paid troops in all circuits follow this regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Capital units outside the rotation cycle and grain-paid troops in all circuits follow the same rule."

sentences.zh: 凡軍頭、十將、節級轉補，謂之「排連」，有司按籍閱試，如列校轉員法。

translations.literal: For all army chiefs, squad sergeants, and squad leaders rotated and filled, this is called "pailian" (rank linkage); the authorities examine registers and test, as with company-grade rank rotation law.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion and filling of army chiefs, squad sergeants, and squad leaders was called "rank linkage"; the responsible office tested men by register, following the same rules as company-grade rank rotation.

sentences.zh: 弓射六斗、弩廣一石七斗、槍刀手稍練並取之。

translations.literal: Bow shooting six dou, crossbow span one shi seven dou, and spearmen and swordsmen somewhat practiced—all were accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates had to shoot a six-dou bow, span a one-shi-seven-dou crossbow, and show reasonable spear or blade skill.

sentences.zh: 如舊不試武技者，即遞遷。

translations.literal: Those who by old rule did not test martial skill advanced in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Men exempted from martial testing under the old rule advanced by seniority alone.

sentences.zh: 其不教閱廂軍節級，則其半遞遷，其半取伉健未嘗犯徒刑、角力勝者充。

translations.literal: For review-exempt garrison squad leaders, half advanced in succession and half were taken from sturdy men who had never committed penal servitude and who won at wrestling.
translations.idiomatic: For garrison squad leaders not subject to review, half were promoted by seniority and half were chosen from sturdy men with no record of penal servitude who had won wrestling matches.

sentences.zh: 治平四年，有司言：「軍士闕額多而將校眾，請以實領兵數製將校額，第其遷補，並通領五都之事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiping, the authorities said: "Soldier vacancies are many while officers are numerous; we request fixing officer quotas by actual troop numbers commanded, ordering their promotion and filling, and having them jointly command all five companies."
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiping 4 the authorities reported: "Troop vacancies are large but officer ranks overcrowded. Fix officer quotas to actual headcounts, regulate promotions accordingly, and let each officer command all five companies in his unit."

sentences.zh: 」乃詔：「二百五十人以上，補指揮使十人，以下七人，闕二人者以次補。

translations.literal: An edict then said: "For 250 men or more, ten company commanders are appointed; below that, seven; when two are vacant, fill by succession."
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered: "Units of 250 men or more have ten company commanders; smaller units have seven. Fill two vacancies by seniority."

sentences.zh: 補十將者，馬軍四十人，步軍如馬軍之數而加其一焉。

translations.literal: To fill squad sergeants: forty horse troops, foot troops the same number as horse plus one.
translations.idiomatic: To appoint squad sergeants required forty horse soldiers, and foot soldiers in the same number plus one.

sentences.zh: 百五十人以上者三十人，闕五人者以次補。

translations.literal: For 150 men or more, thirty men; when five are vacant, fill by succession.
translations.idiomatic: Units of 150 men or more required thirty candidates; fill five vacancies by seniority.

sentences.zh: 不及百五十人者，如舊格，補單將二十人。」

translations.literal: Under 150 men, per the old rule, twenty single sergeants were appointed."
translations.idiomatic: Units under 150 men followed the old rule and appointed twenty single sergeants."

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，樞密院請：「自今捧日、龍衛、天武、神衛廂都指揮使闕，無當次遷者，並虛之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, the Bureau of Military Affairs requested: "From now on, when Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Heavenly Martial, and Divine Guard division commander posts are vacant and no one is due to rotate up, leave them vacant."
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 2 the Bureau of Military Affairs asked that vacancies for division commanders of Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Heavenly Martial, and Divine Guard be left unfilled when no man was due for promotion.

sentences.zh: 其諸軍都指揮使、都虞候當遷者，闕多則間一名補轉，兼以次職事。

translations.literal: For army commanders-in-chief and adjutants due to rotate, if vacancies are many, fill every other man and combine with acting lower duties.
translations.idiomatic: When many army commander or adjutant posts were due to rotate, promote every other eligible man and assign acting lower duties as needed.

sentences.zh: 吐渾等軍都指揮使、都虞候闕者，虛其闕。

translations.literal: Vacancies for Tuhun and similar army commanders and adjutants are left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies among Tuhun and similar units were also left unfilled.

sentences.zh: 」六月，詔：「河東、陝西就糧軍士將校，其間材效之人，孤遠無由自達，有司審度其有軍功驍勇者以名聞，當擢寘班行，以備本路任使。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict said: "Among grain-paid officers of Hedong and Shaanxi, able men in remote places have no way to make themselves known; the authorities should examine those with battle merit and valor, report their names, and promote them to the ranks for service on their circuit."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month an edict ordered that able grain-paid officers in Hedong and Shaanxi who could not reach the court be identified by merit and valor, reported by name, and promoted for service on their circuit.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「諸班直嘗備宿衛，病告滿尚可療者，殿前指揮使補外牢城指揮使，餘以為捧日、天武第五軍押營，奉錢三千者予五百，二千以下者予三百。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict said: "Duty platoon men who once served as palace guards, when sick leave expires and they can still be treated—Palace Front company commanders become outside prison-garrison commanders; the rest become Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial fifth-army camp supervisors; those with pay of 3,000 receive 500, those under 2,000 receive 300."
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict ordered that former palace guards on sick leave who could still serve: Palace Front company commanders became outside prison-garrison commanders; others became camp supervisors in Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial fifth armies, with stipends of 500 for men paid 3,000 and 300 for those paid under 2,000.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔：「軍校老而諳部轄者優假之；

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict said: "Officers who are old and skilled in commanding are given favorable treatment;
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 an edict ordered favorable treatment for elderly officers skilled in command;

sentences.zh: 雖疾不至罷癃，或未七十猶堪任事者勿罷。

translations.literal: though ill, if not reduced to total disability, or not yet seventy and still fit for duty, do not dismiss.
translations.idiomatic: do not dismiss men whose illness falls short of total disability, or who are under seventy and still fit for duty.

sentences.zh: 即法雖當留而不能部轄者以聞，當議處之廂軍。

translations.literal: Those whom the law would retain but who cannot command should be reported, and placement in garrison troops deliberated."
translations.idiomatic: Report men whom the law would keep but who can no longer command, so that garrison placement may be decided."

sentences.zh: 」十月，詔：「軍士選為節級，取兩嘗有功者，功等以先後，又等以重輕，又等以傷多者為上。」

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict said: "In selecting soldiers as squad leaders, take those who have twice won merit; equal merit by precedence, then by severity, then by number of wounds, the more wounds ranking higher."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an edict ordered that squad leaders be chosen from men with two meritorious records; ties were broken by date, then severity, then number of wounds.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔：「十將以下當轉資而不欲者，凡一資，以功者賜帛十五匹，技優者十匹。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, an edict said: "For squad sergeants and below due to rotate in grade but unwilling, for each grade: those with merit receive fifteen bolts of silk, those with superior skill ten bolts."
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 an edict offered men below squad sergeant who declined promotion one grade's reward: fifteen bolts of silk for merit, ten for superior skill.

sentences.zh: 」六月，詔：「在京轉員諸軍都虞候已上至軍都指揮使，以軍功當遷而願以授子孫者聽，視其秩有差。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict said: "For capital rank rotation from army adjutant up to army commander, those due to advance on battle merit who wish to confer it on descendants are permitted, with differences by rank."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month an edict allowed capital officers from army adjutant through army commander due to advance on battle merit to pass the benefit to descendants, with rewards scaled by rank.

sentences.zh: 八年，轉員，帝親閱，凡三日。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, at rank rotation, the emperor personally inspected for three days in all.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 the emperor personally inspected the rank rotation for three full days.

sentences.zh: 舊制，捧日都虞候四人，至是，補者五人，而馬軍都指揮使闕驍騎二人，以捧日一人補驍騎軍主，餘四人如故，則次軍皆不得遷，乃補四人者皆為馬步軍副都軍頭。

translations.literal: By old rule there were four Sun-Bearing adjutants; at this time five were appointed, while the horse army commander had two Valiant Cavalry vacancies; one Sun-Bearing man was used to fill a Valiant Cavalry army chief post, the other four remaining as before—then secondary corps could not rotate, so the four appointees all became deputy chiefs of the horse and foot armies.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule there were four Sun-Bearing adjutants; now five were appointed. The horse army commander still had two Valiant Cavalry slots unfilled, so one Sun-Bearing man was posted as Valiant Cavalry army chief while the other four stayed in place. Because subordinate corps could no longer rotate, all four new appointees were made deputy chiefs of the horse and foot armies.

sentences.zh: 舊龍衛、拱聖、驍騎、武騎、寧朔、神騎為一百三十一營，今省五十營，而馬軍指揮以下已補八十一營，補外尚有溢員，乃詔所省營未移並者凡四十三，每營權置下名指揮使、副指揮使各一，軍使三，以便遞遷。

translations.literal: Formerly Dragon Guard, Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, Martial Cavalry, Ningshuo, and Divine Cavalry totaled 131 camps; now fifty camps were cut, while horse army company commanders and below had already filled eighty-one camps, and beyond that there were still excess men—thus an edict ordered that the forty-three among the cut camps not yet merged or relocated would each temporarily have one acting company commander, one acting deputy company commander, and three battalion officers, to facilitate successive promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Guard, Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, Martial Cavalry, Ningshuo, and Divine Cavalry once numbered 131 camps. After cutting fifty camps, company commanders and junior horse officers had already filled eighty-one posts, with men still to spare. The court therefore ordered that the forty-three camps not yet consolidated each receive one acting company commander, one acting deputy, and three battalion officers to keep the promotion queue moving.

sentences.zh: 九年，將轉員，樞密院奏：「換官稍優，軍校由行伍有功，不久乃至團練使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, as rank rotation approached, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "Civil exchange is somewhat generous—officers who rise from the ranks with merit soon reach regimental training commissioner."
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, on the eve of rank rotation, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that the terms of civil exchange were too generous: common soldiers with battlefield merit could reach regimental training commissioner in only a few steps.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「祖宗以來，軍製固有意。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Since the founding ancestors, the military system has had its intent."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "The military system has always had a purpose, ever since our founding."

sentences.zh: 凡隸在京殿前、馬步軍司所統諸營，置軍都指揮使、都虞候分領之。

translations.literal: All camps under the Palace Front and horse and foot commands in the capital have army commanders-in-chief and adjutants assigned to command them separately.
translations.idiomatic: Every camp under the Palace Front and Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands in the capital has its own army commander and adjutant.

sentences.zh: 凡軍事，止責分領節制之人。

translations.literal: For all military affairs, only those assigned to command separately are held responsible.
translations.idiomatic: Military responsibility falls solely on the officers assigned to command each unit.

sentences.zh: 責之既嚴，則遇之不得不優。

translations.literal: Once responsibility is that strict, treatment can hardly fail to be generous.
translations.idiomatic: Strict accountability demands equally generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 至若諸路，則軍校不過各領一營，不可比也。

translations.literal: As for the circuits, officers there command at most one camp each—it cannot be compared.
translations.idiomatic: On the circuits, by contrast, an officer commands at most a single camp, and the two systems are not comparable.

sentences.zh: 」吳充等以本大末小對，帝然之。

translations.literal: Wu Chong and others responded with the principle that the root is large and the branches small; the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chong and others explained that the capital commands the root while the circuits are the branches; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 因言：「周室雖盛，成、康之後，浸以衰微。

translations.literal: Continuing, they said: "Though the Zhou flourished, after Cheng and Kang it gradually declined."
translations.idiomatic: They added: "The Zhou dynasty was glorious, yet after Kings Cheng and Kang it slowly weakened."

sentences.zh: 本朝太平百有餘年，由祖宗法度具在，豈可輕改也？」

translations.literal: Our dynasty has been at peace for more than a hundred years because the ancestral statutes remain intact—how can they be lightly altered?"
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty has enjoyed more than a century of peace because ancestral institutions remain intact. How can we change them lightly?"

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，詔禁軍排連者三分其人，以其一取立功額外人，二分如令簡試。

translations.literal: In Yuanfeng 1, an edict ordered that for palace guard rank linkage, the men were divided into three parts: one part taken from meritorious men outside the quota, two parts tested by simplified rule.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 1 an edict ordered that palace guard rank linkage draw one third of appointees from men with meritorious service outside the quota and select the remaining two thirds through the standard simplified test.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔諸軍軍使、都頭以下並充兵額，正副指揮使以上置於額外，軍行則分押諸隊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered that battalion officers and squad chiefs and below all count toward troop quotas, while principal and deputy company commanders and above were placed outside the quota; on campaign they separately supervised the various squads.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict ruled that battalion officers and squad chiefs and below counted toward troop quotas, while company commanders and above were held outside it, supervising squads separately when the army marched.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「內殿直以下諸班直闕，按籍闕二分者虛其闕四之一，二分以上亦如之，不及二分補其半，餘並闕之。」

translations.literal: Another edict said: "For vacancies among Inner Palace Duty and lower duty platoons, where the register shows vacancies of two-tenths, leave one quarter of those vacant; for two-tenths or more likewise; for less than two-tenths fill half; all remainder leave vacant."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that for vacancies in the Inner Palace Duty platoons and below, when the register showed a two-tenths shortfall, leave one quarter of the slots unfilled; apply the same rule for larger shortfalls; for shortfalls under two-tenths fill half the gap and leave the rest open.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「五路袞轉土軍與諸路不袞轉禁軍法，十將、副都頭、副兵馬使、都頭、軍使並如令。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered: "The rotating-transfer rules for native troops on the Five Circuits and the non-rotating palace guard rules on other circuits—for squad sergeants, deputy squad chiefs, deputy horse-and-arms officers, squad chiefs, and battalion officers—all follow present orders."
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict applied the same rules to squad sergeants, deputy squad chiefs, deputy horse-and-arms officers, squad chiefs, and battalion officers under both the Five-Circuit rotating native-troop system and the standard palace guard rules elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 自副都指揮使至都虞候嘗轉資者，間以賜帛，已賜帛乃遷。」

translations.literal: For those from deputy division commander through adjutant who are due to rotate in grade, silk bolts are granted at intervals; only after receiving silk are they advanced."
translations.idiomatic: Officers from deputy division commander through adjutant due for grade rotation receive silk bolts at intervals and advance only after receiving them."

sentences.zh: 五年，詔以諸路教閱廂軍為下禁軍，排連如禁軍法。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict ordered that reviewed garrison troops on all circuits be treated as lower palace guard, with rank linkage as under palace guard law.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 reviewed garrison troops on all circuits were classified as lower palace guard and promoted by the same rank-linkage rules.

sentences.zh: 七年，樞密院言：「騎軍諸營、諸班直以年勞陞至軍使者甚眾，無闕可補。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Cavalry camps and duty platoons have many men advanced by seniority to battalion officer—there are no vacancies to fill."
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 the Bureau reported that seniority had promoted so many cavalry and duty-platoon men to battalion officer that no vacancies remained.

sentences.zh: 」詔捧日、龍衛、拱聖、驍騎、雲騎、驍勝權置下名軍使，凡二百四十員，拱聖、驍騎、雲騎權置副兵馬使，凡九十員以處之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Valiant Victory to establish acting battalion officers, 240 in all; Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, and Cloud Cavalry to establish acting deputy horse-and-arms officers, 90 in all, to accommodate them.
translations.idiomatic: The court created 240 acting battalion officer posts across Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Valiant Victory, plus 90 acting deputy horse-and-arms officers in Gongsheng, Valiant Cavalry, and Cloud Cavalry, to absorb the excess.

sentences.zh: 二年，樞密院言：「舊例，行門對御呈試武藝，並臨時特旨推恩，前期未嘗按試，至日旋乞增加鬥力，或涉唐突，因以抵罪，請於轉員前一日按定鬪力。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Bureau said: "By old rule, Gate Corps martial skill was presented before the emperor and grace was conferred by special edict on the spot; no prior calibration was made; on the day men would beg to increase draw weight, sometimes presumptuously, and were punished—we request fixing draw weight one day before rank rotation."
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 the Bureau noted that Gate Corps candidates once presented martial skill before the throne for on-the-spot favors without prior testing, then pleaded at the last moment to raise draw weights—sometimes presumptuously enough to be punished. It asked that draw weights be fixed one day before rank rotation.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 四月，樞密院言：「舊例，諸班直長行補諸軍員僚，並取入班及轉班二十年、年四十以上人。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the Bureau said: "By old rule, duty platoon senior men filling army staff posts all required twenty years in platoon service and platoon rotation, and age forty or above."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Bureau recalled that duty-platoon senior men appointed to army staff posts had to have twenty years of platoon service and be at least forty.

sentences.zh: 迨元豐四年，以闕額數多，乃特詔減五年，係一時之命。

translations.literal: By Yuanfeng 4, because vacancies were many, a special edict cut five years—it was a temporary order.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 4, with so many vacancies, the court temporarily cut the requirement by five years.

sentences.zh: 今諸軍員僚溢額，儻不定制，即異時遷補不行；

translations.literal: Now army staff posts exceed quota; if rules are not fixed, promotion and filling will not work in future;
translations.idiomatic: Army staff posts are now over quota; without permanent rules, future promotions will stall;

sentences.zh: 若便依限年舊法，又慮未有合該出職之人。

translations.literal: If the old term limits are restored at once, we fear there will not yet be men qualified to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring the old term limits immediately would leave too few qualified candidates.

sentences.zh: 請於三次漸次增及舊例年限。

translations.literal: We request increasing over three rounds until the old term is reached.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau asked to restore the old term in three gradual steps.

sentences.zh: 」 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，樞密院言：「轉員馬軍指揮使以下至副兵馬使，人數溢額，轉遷不行。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Bureau said: "At rank rotation, horse army company commanders down through deputy horse-and-arms officers exceed quota—rotation does not proceed."
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the Bureau reported that at rank rotation horse company commanders through deputy horse-and-arms officers exceeded their quotas and rotation had stalled.

sentences.zh: 」詔權置下名軍使一百七十人，副兵馬使一百七十五人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered 170 acting battalion officers and 175 acting deputy horse-and-arms officers.
translations.idiomatic: The court created 170 acting battalion officers and 175 acting deputy horse-and-arms officers.

sentences.zh: 又言：「禁軍大閱，請以匹帛、銀楪支賜，罷轉資。

translations.literal: They further said: "At the palace guard grand review, grant payment in bolts of silk and silver dishes, and abolish grade rotation."
translations.idiomatic: They also proposed paying grand-review honorees in silk and silver rather than grade promotions.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 六年，又言：「應排連長行充承局、押官者，先取年五十五以下、有戰功公據者，仍以戰功多少、得功先後、傷中輕重為次，事等而俱無傷中，則以事藝營名為次。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, they further said: "For rank-linkage senior men appointed as bureau heads and escort officers, first take those under fifty-five with documented battle merit; order by amount of merit, date earned, and severity of wounds; when equal and none wounded, order by skill grade and camp name."
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 they proposed that rank-linkage senior men chosen as bureau heads and escort officers be under fifty-five with documented battle merit, ranked by merit, date, and wound severity, then by skill grade and camp when ties remained.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 紹聖二年，詔：「將來轉員換前班人，並從元豐轉員令，仍不得過一百二十人。

translations.literal: In Shaosheng 2, an edict ordered: "For future rank rotation, men exchanging to front-platoon civil service all follow Yuanfeng rank-rotation orders, and shall not exceed 120 men."
translations.idiomatic: In Shaosheng 2 an edict capped front-platoon civil exchanges at 120 men under the Yuanfeng rotation rules.

sentences.zh: 元祐所限人數比試家狀指揮勿用。」

translations.literal: Do not use the Yuanyou cap on numbers, comparison testing, or household-register orders."
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou limits on numbers, comparison testing, and household registers were revoked."

sentences.zh: 三年，樞密院進呈轉員及行門試武藝、換前班、留住等條例。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Bureau presented regulations on rank rotation, Gate Corps martial testing, front-platoon exchange, and retention.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 the Bureau submitted regulations on rank rotation, Gate Corps martial tests, front-platoon exchange, and retention.

sentences.zh: 曾布言：「國初以來，皆麵問其所欲，察相人才，或換官，或遷將校，或再任，此則威福在人主。

translations.literal: Zeng Bu said: "Since the founding, the emperor always questioned each man face to face, assessed talent, and might exchange for civil office, promote an officer, or reappoint him—thus favor and authority rested with the sovereign."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu argued that since the founding the emperor had always questioned candidates in person, judged their talent, and decided whether to exchange them into civil office, promote them, or reappoint them—keeping favor and authority in imperial hands.

sentences.zh: 以至唐突，或放罪，或行法，亦視其情狀而操縱之。

translations.literal: Even when presumptuous, he might pardon or punish according to circumstance and control the outcome.
translations.idiomatic: Even when a man was presumptuous, the emperor could pardon or punish as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 元祐改法，乃令大閹與三司、軍頭司先指試定，但對御引呈，依拍定等第推恩，殊失祖宗馭眾之法。

translations.literal: The Yuanyou reform had the chief eunuch, Finance Commission, and Army Chiefs Office fix grades in advance; at presentation before the throne they merely followed the set grades—greatly losing the ancestral method of controlling the host.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanyou reform let the chief eunuch, Finance Commission, and Army Chiefs Office fix grades in advance, reducing the palace presentation to a rubber stamp—abandoning the ancestral way of commanding the ranks.

sentences.zh: 不許唐突，例坐徒罪兼決責人員，皆非舊法。

translations.literal: Forbidding presumptuous behavior, routinely imposing penal servitude and corporal punishment on staff—none of this was old law.
translations.idiomatic: Bans on presumptuous pleading, routine penal servitude, and mandatory beatings were all innovations, not old law.

sentences.zh: 唐突人雖有理，亦不施行。

translations.literal: Men who were presumptuous were not granted favor even when their case had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Even meritorious men who spoke out of turn were denied.

sentences.zh: 緣情輕者放罪，重者取旨，自有舊格。

translations.literal: Light cases were pardoned and serious ones referred for imperial decision—old rules existed for this.
translations.idiomatic: Old rules already distinguished light cases for pardon from serious ones requiring imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 先朝燕達、林廣嘗唐突當降配，先帝釋之，後皆為名將。

translations.literal: Under the previous reign Yan Da and Lin Guang were once presumptuous and should have been demoted and exiled; the previous emperor released them, and both later became famous generals.
translations.idiomatic: Under the previous emperor Yan Da and Lin Guang had been presumptuous enough to merit demotion and exile, yet were released and went on to become famous generals.

sentences.zh: 至情重則杖脊配嶺表者，有王明者住留叫呼，云：『若不得換前班，乞納命。

translations.literal: When the offense was grave enough for spine flogging and exile to the Ling region, one Wang Ming cried out on being detained: "If I may not exchange to front-platoon civil service, I beg to surrender my life."
translations.idiomatic: In a grave case warranting spine flogging and exile to the south, Wang Ming shouted while being held back: "If I cannot take front-platoon civil exchange, I offer my life."

sentences.zh: 』管軍賈逵乞重配，先帝亦貸之，但降一等，與換外官。

translations.literal: The commanding officer Jia Kui asked for heavier exile; the previous emperor also spared him, merely lowering one grade and granting civil exchange outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Commanding officer Jia Kui asked for harsher punishment; the previous emperor spared him too, cutting one grade and assigning him a civil post outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 如此，故人知恩威皆自人主出，豈可一切付之有司？

translations.literal: Thus men knew that favor and authority both came from the sovereign—how can everything be left to the officials?
translations.idiomatic: Men knew that favor and fear alike came from the throne. How could all of this be delegated to officials?

sentences.zh: 」帝悅，詔令並依元豐以前條例施行。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and ordered all to follow pre-Yuanfeng regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered a return to pre-Yuanfeng rules.

sentences.zh: 五年，馬步軍司言：「三路袞轉軍員，請依元豐七年詔，『應三月一日後續有得功嵌補陞名並改轉名職自充下名者，並依先補名次，各理降宣月日以為高下，審會給據，候再經袞轉，即依嵌補陞轉名次高下轉那。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the horse and foot commands said: "For Three-Circuit rotating personnel, follow the Yuanfeng 7 edict: 'For those after the first of March who receive merit-based interim promotion and change title or fill acting lower titles, all follow the original appointment order, ranking by edict date; verify credentials; after a second rotation, move according to interim promotion order.'"
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the horse and foot commands asked that Three-Circuit rotating personnel follow the Yuanfeng 7 rule: men promoted on merit after March 1 who changed title or filled acting lower posts would keep their original appointment order, ranked by edict date, with credentials verified; after a second rotation they would move according to interim promotion rank.

sentences.zh: 』自今三路軍員袞轉亦如之。

translations.literal: From now on Three-Circuit personnel rotating transfer likewise."
translations.idiomatic: The same rule would apply to all Three-Circuit rotating personnel from then on."

sentences.zh: 」詔侍衛馬、步軍司，自今開具合轉補職名申樞密院降宣，餘並從之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands from now on to list eligible rotation titles and report to the Bureau for edicts; the rest was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Imperial Bodyguard horse and foot commands to submit eligible rotation titles to the Bureau for edicts; the rest was approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，軍頭司引見殿前、馬步軍司揀到御龍諸直人材事藝應格，並補逐直將虞候，賜杖子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Army Chiefs Office presented Imperial Dragon duty platoon men selected by the Palace Front and horse and foot commands for physique and skill; all were appointed adjutants of their platoons and given batons.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Army Chiefs Office presented Imperial Dragon platoon men whom the Palace Front and horse and foot commands had selected for physique and skill; all were appointed platoon adjutants and given batons.

sentences.zh: 一名開弓偃身不應法，黜之。

translations.literal: One man drew the bow with improper body posture and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: One candidate's bow draw failed the posture test and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月，樞密院言：

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs said:
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Bureau of Military Affairs reported:

sentences.zh: 《轉員旁通格》：「捧日、天武不帶遙刺軍都指揮使，換左藏庫使，仍除遙刺；

translations.literal: Supplementary Rank-Rotation Regulations: "Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial army commanders without titular prefectships exchange for Left Treasury Commissioner and shed the titular prefectship;
translations.idiomatic: The Supplementary Rank-Rotation Regulations state that Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial army commanders without titular prefectships exchange for Left Treasury Commissioner and shed the titular prefectship;

sentences.zh: 殿前班不帶遙刺都虞候，換左藏庫使。

translations.literal: Palace Front platoon adjutants without titular prefectships exchange for Left Treasury Commissioner."
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front platoon adjutants without titular prefectships exchange for Left Treasury Commissioner."

sentences.zh: 」看詳殿前班帶遙郡都虞候，係與捧日帶遙郡軍都指揮使理先後相壓轉遷；

translations.literal: On review, Palace Front platoon adjutants with titular prefectural commissions rank with Sun-Bearing army commanders with titular prefectural commissions for precedence in overlapping rotation;
translations.idiomatic: On review, Palace Front platoon adjutants with titular prefectural commissions rank with Sun-Bearing army commanders with titular prefectural commissions for overlapping rotation precedence;

sentences.zh: 其不帶遙郡殿前班都虞候、捧日軍都指揮使換官班，合一等推恩。

translations.literal: Palace Front platoon adjutants and Sun-Bearing army commanders without titular prefectural commissions exchanging for civil rank should receive equal favor.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front platoon adjutants and Sun-Bearing army commanders without titular prefectural commissions should receive equal civil-exchange benefits.

sentences.zh: 欲殿前班不帶遙郡都虞候，依捧日不帶遙郡軍都指揮使換官。

translations.literal: We propose that Palace Front platoon adjutants without titular prefectural commissions exchange for civil office like Sun-Bearing army commanders without titular prefectural commissions.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau proposed that Palace Front platoon adjutants without titular prefectural commissions exchange for civil office on the same terms as Sun-Bearing army commanders without titular prefectural commissions.

sentences.zh: 又拱聖、神勇與驍騎已下軍分有異，其逐軍都虞候、指揮使理難一等換官。

translations.literal: Also Gongsheng and Divine Valor differ from Valiant Cavalry and lower corps; their adjutants and company commanders can hardly exchange civil office at one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsheng and Divine Valor also differ from Valiant Cavalry and lower corps, so their adjutants and company commanders cannot fairly exchange civil office at a single grade.

sentences.zh: 欲拱聖、神勇都虞候依舊換供備庫使外，驍騎、雲騎、宣武都虞候換左藏庫副使，拱聖、神勇指揮使換內殿承製。

translations.literal: We propose that Gongsheng and Divine Valor adjutants continue exchanging for Equipment Depot Commissioner; Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display adjutants exchange for Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner; Gongsheng and Divine Valor company commanders exchange for Inner Palace Artisan.
translations.idiomatic: It proposed that Gongsheng and Divine Valor adjutants continue exchanging for Equipment Depot Commissioner; Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display adjutants for Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner; and Gongsheng and Divine Valor company commanders for Inner Palace Artisan.

sentences.zh: 捧日、天武、神、龍衛指揮使皆係上四軍，其捧日、天武換西京左藏庫副使，龍、神衛換內殿承製，比捧日、天武隔兩官，理有未均，欲神、龍衛指揮使換供備庫副使。

translations.literal: Sun-Bearing, Heavenly Martial, Divine, and Dragon Guard company commanders all belong to the upper four armies; Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial exchange for Western Capital Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner, Dragon and Divine Guard exchange for Inner Palace Artisan—two ranks apart from Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial, which seems unfair; we propose Dragon and Divine Guard company commanders exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sun-Bearing, Heavenly Martial, Divine Guard, and Dragon Guard company commanders all belong to the upper four armies. Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial exchanged for Western Capital Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner while Dragon and Divine Guard exchanged for Inner Palace Artisan—two ranks lower than Sun-Bearing and Heavenly Martial, which seemed unfair. The Bureau proposed Dragon and Divine Guard company commanders exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 又殿前班上名副都知換供備庫副使，下名副都知換內殿承製，自來以左右第一、第二班為資次，欲第一班換供備庫副使，第二班換內殿承製。

translations.literal: Also Palace Front upper deputy directors exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner and lower deputy directors for Inner Palace Artisan; traditionally left and right first and second platoons set seniority; we propose first platoon exchanges for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner and second for Inner Palace Artisan.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front upper deputy directors had exchanged for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner and lower deputy directors for Inner Palace Artisan; traditionally the left and right first and second platoons set seniority. The Bureau proposed the first platoon exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner and the second for Inner Palace Artisan.

sentences.zh: 又：「換前班差遣，州總管以下，並以五路緣邊為優，諸路為次。

translations.literal: Also: "For front-platoon exchange assignments, from prefectural commander downward, the Five Circuit border zones are preferred and other circuits secondary."
translations.idiomatic: It also noted that for front-platoon exchange assignments, from prefectural commander downward, the Five Circuit border zones were preferred and other circuits secondary.

sentences.zh: 正團練使，州總管；

translations.literal: Full regimental training commissioner, prefectural commander;
translations.idiomatic: Full regimental training commissioner, prefectural commander;

sentences.zh: 正刺史，州鈐轄；

translations.literal: Full prefect, prefectural military controller;
translations.idiomatic: Full prefect, prefectural military controller;

sentences.zh: 諸司使副，都巡檢使、駐泊都監；

translations.literal: Commissioners and deputies of various offices, circuit inspector, stationed garrison supervisor;
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners and deputies of various offices, circuit inspector, stationed garrison supervisor;

sentences.zh: 內殿承製、崇班，巡檢、州都監；

translations.literal: Inner Palace Artisan and Honored Attendant, inspector, prefectural garrison supervisor;
translations.idiomatic: Inner Palace Artisan and Honored Attendant, inspector, prefectural garrison supervisor;

sentences.zh: 供奉官至借職，教押軍隊指使。

translations.literal: Court attendant through provisional appointee, drill instructor of army detachments.
translations.idiomatic: Court attendant through provisional appointee, drill instructor of army detachments.

sentences.zh: 」看詳諸司使、副已上差遣，見依格施行外，承製以下，欲依今來轉員所差遣例。

translations.literal: On review, for commissioners and deputies and above, existing regulations apply; for Artisan and below, we propose following present rank-rotation assignment practice.
translations.idiomatic: For commissioners and deputies and above, existing regulations would stand; for Artisan and below, the Bureau proposed following present rank-rotation assignment practice.

sentences.zh: 又：「拱聖、神勇、驍騎、雲騎、宣武軍都指揮使換文思，仍除遙刺，已帶者依舊；

translations.literal: Also: "Gongsheng, Divine Valor, Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display army commanders exchange for Literary Enterprise Commissioner and shed titular prefectship; those already holding it remain as before;
translations.idiomatic: It also proposed that Gongsheng, Divine Valor, Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display army commanders exchange for Literary Enterprise Commissioner and shed titular prefectship, while those already holding it remain as before;

sentences.zh: 御龍直都虞候，文思使，帶遙刺者依舊；

translations.literal: Imperial Dragon platoon adjutants exchange for Literary Enterprise Commissioner; those with titular prefectship remain as before;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dragon platoon adjutants would exchange for Literary Enterprise Commissioner; those with titular prefectship would remain as before;

sentences.zh: 內殿直兩次都虞候換左藏庫使，一次文思使，帶遙刺者依舊。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Duty adjutants twice exchange for Left Treasury Commissioner, once for Literary Enterprise Commissioner; those with titular prefectship remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Palace Duty adjutants would exchange twice for Left Treasury Commissioner and once for Literary Enterprise Commissioner; those with titular prefectship would remain as before.

sentences.zh: 」看詳拱聖、神勇與驍騎以下軍分有異，兼御龍直都虞候遇轉員合次神勇軍都指揮使轉行，及係環衛諸直人員最上名人，兼內殿直都虞候以次殿前班，及轉員無闕，合隨龍衛軍都指揮使轉行，理難於驍騎、雲騎、宣武軍都指揮使之下換官。

translations.literal: On review, Gongsheng and Divine Valor differ from Valiant Cavalry and below; Imperial Dragon platoon adjutants at rotation should follow Divine Valor army commanders; as top men among guard platoons and Inner Palace Duty adjutants ranking after Palace Front platoons, when rotation has no vacancy they should follow Dragon Guard army commanders—it is hard to place them below Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display army commanders for civil exchange.
translations.idiomatic: On review, Gongsheng and Divine Valor differ from Valiant Cavalry and lower corps.
