Imperial Dragon platoon adjutants at rotation should follow Divine Valor army commanders; as the top men among guard platoons and Inner Palace Duty adjutants ranking after Palace Front platoons, when rotation had no vacancy they should follow Dragon Guard army commanders. It was hard to place them below Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display army commanders for civil exchange.

sentences.zh: 欲御龍直、內殿直都虞候依格合換官外，並除遙刺；

translations.literal: We propose that Imperial Dragon and Inner Palace Duty adjutants, aside from civil exchange under regulation, all shed titular prefectship;
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau proposed that Imperial Dragon and Inner Palace Duty adjutants, aside from civil exchange under regulation, all shed titular prefectship;

sentences.zh: 驍騎、雲騎、宣武軍都指揮使止與換文思使，更不除遙郡刺史，內已帶遙刺者並依舊。

translations.literal: Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display army commanders receive only Literary Enterprise Commissioner and no longer receive titular prefectural commission; those already holding titular prefectship remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Valiant Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Martial Display army commanders would receive only Literary Enterprise Commissioner and no longer receive titular prefectural commission; those already holding titular prefectship would remain as before.

sentences.zh: 內殿前班副都知並與換供備庫副使。

translations.literal: Inner Palace and Palace Front deputy directors all exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Palace and Palace Front deputy directors would all exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 今馬步軍諸指揮事藝高強十將引見，取揀充員僚，內弓箭手短一指箭人合降一軍安排；

translations.literal: Now Palace Front and horse and foot company commanders present skilled squad sergeants for selection as staff officers; among them archers one finger short in arrow should be demoted one army grade in placement;
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front and horse and foot company commanders were presenting skilled squad sergeants for staff selection; among them archers one finger short on the arrow should be placed one army grade lower;

sentences.zh: 弩手括不發，事體頗同，並弩手墜箭與括不發亦同，欲並降一軍安排。

translations.literal: Crossbowmen whose catch fails to release is much the same; crossbowmen who drop the arrow and catch failure are likewise the same; we propose demoting all one army grade in placement.
translations.idiomatic: Crossbowmen whose catch failed to release presented much the same problem, as did those who dropped the arrow; the Bureau proposed placing all such men one army grade lower.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，樞密院言：「《轉員旁通冊》內御龍直都虞候至都頭副換官，惟指揮使上兩直與文思副使係降兩資，餘止降一資，散員至金槍都知、副都知皆換內殿承製，不惟職名有差，自副都知約六遷方轉都知；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Bureau said: "In the Supplementary Rank-Rotation Register, from Imperial Dragon platoon adjutant through deputy squad chief for civil exchange, only the two platoons above company commander with Deputy Literary Enterprise Commissioner drop two grades; the rest drop only one. From irregular attendant through Golden Spear deputy directors all exchange for Inner Palace Artisan—not only do titles differ, but from deputy director it takes about six promotions to reach director;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Bureau reported that in the Supplementary Rank-Rotation Register, from Imperial Dragon platoon adjutant through deputy squad chief for civil exchange, only the two platoons above company commander with Deputy Literary Enterprise Commissioner dropped two grades while the rest dropped one. From irregular attendant through Golden Spear deputy directors all exchanged for Inner Palace Artisan—not only did the titles differ, but from deputy director it took about six promotions to reach director;

sentences.zh: 兼東西班、散直、鈞容直係近下班分，副都知亦降都知一等換內殿崇班。

translations.literal: Those also holding East-West Platoon, Scattered Duty, and Jung Rong Duty belong to the near-lower platoon ranks; deputy directors also drop one grade below director for Inner Hall Honored Attendant exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Men who also served East-West Platoon, Scattered Duty, or Jung Rong Duty belonged to the near-lower platoon ranks, and their deputy directors likewise exchanged for Inner Hall Honored Attendant one grade below a director.

sentences.zh: 其東西班、散直押班與副都知職名不等，兩經轉遷，方入近下班分副都知，理難與都知一等換內殿崇班。

translations.literal: East-West Platoon and Scattered Duty platoon leads and deputy directors have unequal titles; only after two rank rotations do they enter near-lower platoon deputy director—it is hard to exchange for Inner Hall Honored Attendant on equal terms with director.
translations.idiomatic: East-West Platoon and Scattered Duty platoon leads and deputy directors held unequal titles; only after two rank rotations did one reach near-lower platoon deputy director. It was unreasonable to exchange for Inner Hall Honored Attendant on the same terms as a director.

sentences.zh: 又散指揮至鈞容直指揮使並換供備庫副使，緣東西班、散直、鈞容直遇轉員，止是遷入上班，亦難一等換官。

translations.literal: Also from Scattered Command through Jung Rong Duty company commanders all exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner; since East-West Platoon, Scattered Duty, and Jung Rong Duty at rank rotation merely advance to upper platoon, it is also hard to exchange at equal grade.
translations.idiomatic: Scattered Command through Jung Rong Duty company commanders all exchanged for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner. Yet at rank rotation East-West Platoon, Scattered Duty, and Jung Rong Duty men merely moved into upper platoons, so equal-grade civil exchange was again hard to justify.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「御龍下兩直指揮使換左藏庫副使，散員、散指揮、散都頭、散祗候，金槍都知換供備庫副使，東西班、散直押班換東頭供奉官，東西班指揮使換官依舊外，散直、鈞容直指揮使換左藏庫副使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered: "Imperial Dragon lower two platoons' company commanders exchange for Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner; irregular attendants, Scattered Command, Scattered Squad Chief, and Scattered Attendant, and Golden Spear directors exchange for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner; East-West Platoon and Scattered Duty platoon leads exchange for Eastern Head Court Attendant; aside from East-West Platoon company commanders exchanging as before, Scattered Duty and Jung Rong Duty company commanders exchange for Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Imperial Dragon lower two platoons' company commanders exchange for Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner; irregular attendants, Scattered Command, Scattered Squad Chief, and Scattered Attendant, and Golden Spear directors for Deputy Equipment Depot Commissioner; East-West Platoon and Scattered Duty platoon leads for Eastern Head Court Attendant; and apart from East-West Platoon company commanders, who exchanged as before, Scattered Duty and Jung Rong Duty company commanders for Deputy Left Treasury Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 」緣《轉員旁通冊》內未載雲、武騎軍都指揮使轉遷換官並恩例等，詔並依驍騎軍都指揮使格。

translations.literal: Because the Supplementary Rank-Rotation Register does not record Cloud Cavalry and Martial Cavalry army commanders' rotation exchange and grace cases, an edict ordered all to follow Valiant Cavalry army commander standards.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Supplementary Rank-Rotation Register did not record civil exchange and grace provisions for Cloud Cavalry and Martial Cavalry army commanders, an edict ordered that both follow the Valiant Cavalry army commander standard.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，軍頭司引見捧日等兵試藝，帝於行間召邢斌、韓扆問曰：「開弓猶有餘力乎？

translations.literal: In the second month of year 4, the Army Chiefs Office presented Sun-Bearing and other troops for martial testing; the emperor in the ranks summoned Xing Bin and Han Yi and asked: "Do you still have strength left in drawing the bow?
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4 the Army Chiefs Office presented Sun-Bearing and other troops for martial testing. Walking the ranks, the emperor summoned Xing Bin and Han Yi and asked, "Do you still have draw left in the bow?

sentences.zh: 」各對願增二石二斗弓。

translations.literal: Each replied that they wished to increase the bow by two shi and two dou.
translations.idiomatic: Each replied that he wished to raise his bow by two shi and two dou.

sentences.zh: 遣內待監定鬥力授之。

translations.literal: Palace attendants were sent to set draw weight and grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendants were sent to fix the draw weight and issue the bows.

sentences.zh: 射皆應法，並特充殿前指揮使，賜緡錢。

translations.literal: All shooting met regulation; all were specially appointed Palace Front company commanders and granted cash.
translations.idiomatic: All shooting met regulation. Both men were specially appointed Palace Front company commanders and granted cash.

sentences.zh: 元符元年七月，樞密院言：「將校、軍頭、十將各轉補者，委本將體量，不掩眼試五次，二十步見，若一次不同，減五步，掩一眼再試。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Yuanfu 1, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "For officers, army chiefs, and squad sergeants rotating and filling vacancies, entrust the home commander to assess; test five times without covering the eyes, seeing at twenty paces; if once different, reduce five paces and test again with one eye covered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Yuanfu 1 the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that officers, army chiefs, and squad sergeants due for rotation fill should be assessed by their home commander: five uncovered-eye tests at twenty paces; if one result failed, reduce the distance by five paces and retest with one eye covered.

sentences.zh: 但兩眼共見二十步，或一眼全不見二十步，仍試上下馬。

translations.literal: If both eyes together see at twenty paces, or one eye cannot see at twenty paces at all, still test mounting and dismounting.
translations.idiomatic: If both eyes together saw at twenty paces, or one eye could not see at twenty paces at all, mounting and dismounting were still tested.

sentences.zh: 如無病切，弓射五斗，弩踏一石五斗，槍刀、標牌手各不至生疏，並與轉補。

translations.literal: If there is no disqualifying illness, bow shoots five dou, crossbow treads one shi five dou, and spear-sword and shield-banner hands are each not rusty—all receive rotation fill.
translations.idiomatic: Men without disqualifying illness who could shoot a five-dou bow, tread a one-shi-five-dou crossbow, and handle spear, sword, or shield without rust were all granted rotation fill.

sentences.zh: 即有病切，或精神尫悴，或將校年六十九，或經轉補後犯奸盜贓罪情罪重以上雖該降，並隔下奏聽旨。

translations.literal: If there is disqualifying illness, or spirit enfeebled, or an officer is sixty-nine, or after rotation fill he commits adultery, theft, or corruption of serious degree though subject to demotion—all report separately for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Cases of disqualifying illness, enfeebled spirit, officers aged sixty-nine, or men who after rotation fill committed adultery, theft, or serious corruption—even when demotion applied—were all reported separately for imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 如差出者勾赴本將體量，在別州者，報所在州體量。

translations.literal: If dispatched out, summon to the home commander for assessment; if in another prefecture, report to that prefecture for assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Men dispatched elsewhere were summoned to their home commander for assessment; those in another prefecture were assessed by report to that prefecture.

sentences.zh: 排連長行充承局、押官者，先取年五十五以下、有兩次以上戰功人填闕，六人更取一名；

translations.literal: For rank linkage of rank-and-file filling bureau clerk and escort officer posts, first take men under fifty-five with two or more battle merits to fill vacancies, one per six men in rotation;
translations.idiomatic: In rank linkage for rank-and-file filling bureau clerk and escort officer posts, men under fifty-five with two or more battle merits were taken first to fill vacancies, one chosen for every six in rotation;

sentences.zh: 餘取年四十以下、武藝高強、無病切人，試兩眼各五次，二十步見者選拍。

translations.literal: the remainder take men under forty, high martial skill, and no disqualifying illness; test both eyes five times each, and those seeing at twenty paces are selected by lot.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder came from men under forty of high martial skill and no disqualifying illness, tested five times with each eye; those who saw at twenty paces were selected by lot.

sentences.zh: 內步軍以闕六分為率，先取弓手一分，次取弩手三分，次取槍牌刀手二分，更有零分者依六分為率，資次取揀，周而復始。

translations.literal: For inner foot armies use a six-tenths vacancy rate: first take one-tenth archers, next three-tenths crossbowmen, next two-tenths spear-shield-sword hands; if there is a remainder fraction, use the six-tenths rate, take by seniority in rotation, and cycle repeats.
translations.idiomatic: Inner foot armies used a six-tenths vacancy rate: one-tenth archers first, then three-tenths crossbowmen, then two-tenths spear-shield-sword hands. Remainder fractions followed the same six-tenths ratio, with selection by seniority in rotation, cycling repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 長行犯徒經決及二年，或軍人因犯移配杖罪經三年、徒罪經四年，或已陞揀軍分又經一年，各無過犯，並聽排連。

translations.literal: Rank-and-file convicted of penal servitude after judgment and two years, or army men transferred by crime after caning three years or penal servitude four years, or already promoted to a selected army unit after one year—all without violations—are permitted rank linkage.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-and-file men two years after a penal-servitude sentence, army men transferred for crime three years after caning or four years after penal servitude, or men already promoted to a selected army unit after one year—all without further violations—were permitted rank linkage.

sentences.zh: 不應充軍人，已投狀後，審會取放逐便，雖未給公憑，其請給差使並罷，有違犯，加凡人二等。

translations.literal: Those unfit to serve as soldiers, after petitioning, were reviewed and approved for expulsion at convenience; though official credentials had not yet been issued, requested stipends and assignments ceased; violations added two grades over commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Men unfit for service who had petitioned were reviewed and approved for expulsion at convenience. Even before official credentials were issued, their stipends and assignments ceased, and violations were punished two grades above those for commoners.

sentences.zh: 不應充軍人，於法許逐便者，並追納元請投軍例物訖，報合屬去處，給公憑放逐便。

translations.literal: Those unfit to serve whom the law permitted to leave at convenience all recovered original enlistment materials, reported the appropriate destination, and were given official credentials and expelled at convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Unfit men whom the law permitted to leave at convenience recovered their original enlistment materials, reported their destination, received official credentials, and were expelled at convenience.

sentences.zh: 如非品官之家，無例物回納，願依舊充軍者聽。

translations.literal: If not from a ranked official family and there were no materials to recover, those wishing to continue service were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If a man came from no ranked official family and had no materials to recover, he might continue in service if he wished.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 三月，禮部言：「檢會故事，臣僚申請諸州軍府管押進奉衙校等，祖宗以來，並加散官。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Ministry of Rites said: "Reviewing precedents, when officials requested various prefectures and garrisons to supervise tribute escort guards, since the founding ancestors all received honorary ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Ministry of Rites reported that, reviewing precedents, officials had asked that tribute escort guards at various prefectures and garrisons receive honorary ranks, as they had since the founding ancestors.

sentences.zh: 自更官制，階散並罷。

translations.literal: Since the office system was reformed, rank and honorary titles were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After the office system was reformed, rank and honorary titles were abolished.

sentences.zh: 既罷階散，若與轉資，似屬太優。

translations.literal: Since honorary ranks were abolished, granting rank advancement as well seems too generous.
translations.idiomatic: With honorary ranks gone, granting rank advancement as well seemed too generous.

sentences.zh: 欲每轉一資，支賜絹二十匹。

translations.literal: We propose that for each rank advancement, twenty bolts of silk be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry proposed twenty bolts of silk for each rank advancement.

sentences.zh: 如一名管押兩處，只許就一處支給。

translations.literal: If one man supervised two posts, payment was permitted from only one.
translations.idiomatic: If one man supervised two posts, he could draw payment from only one.

sentences.zh: 或一州一軍差二人同押，亦共與上件支賜。

translations.literal: Or if one prefecture or garrison sent two men to supervise jointly, they too jointly received the above grant.
translations.idiomatic: If one prefecture or garrison sent two men to supervise jointly, they shared the same grant.

sentences.zh: 若一員官兩處進奉，只隨本官合推恩處從一支給。

translations.literal: If one official had tribute duties at two places, payment followed only the one place where the official qualified for grace.
translations.idiomatic: If one official had tribute duties at two places, payment followed only the post where he qualified for grace.

sentences.zh: 今押進奉皇帝登寶位禮物衙校等，欲依故例施行。

translations.literal: For tribute escorts bearing gifts for the emperor's ascension, we propose following the old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: For escorts bearing the emperor's ascension gifts, the Ministry proposed following the old precedent.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: All approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年十一月，南郊，制：「應軍員送軍頭司未得與差遣者，如後來別無過犯，卻與差遣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of Xuanhe 7, at the southern suburban sacrifice, a decree ordered: "Soldiers sent to the Army Chiefs Office who had not yet received assignment—if later they had no violations—should still receive assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Xuanhe 7, at the southern suburban sacrifice, a decree ordered that soldiers sent to the Army Chiefs Office who had not yet received assignment should still receive one if they later committed no violations.

sentences.zh: 應廂軍人員補職及十五年未經遷補者，令所屬保明聞奏。

translations.literal: Auxiliary army men who had filled posts fifteen years without promotion—the subordinate unit should certify and report.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary army men who had held posts fifteen years without promotion were to be certified and reported by their unit.

sentences.zh: 應禁軍、廂軍因一犯濫情重不得補充人員及遞遷資給者，若經斷及五年不曾再犯，及不曾犯贓，委所在候排連日審實，特與不礙遷補。」

translations.literal: Forbidden and auxiliary army men barred from filling posts and sequential benefits because of one serious offense—if after judgment five years they had not offended again and had not committed corruption—let the locality verify on rank-linkage day and specially grant promotion without impediment."
translations.idiomatic: Forbidden and auxiliary army men barred from filling posts and sequential benefits after one serious offense—if five years after judgment they had not offended again and had not committed corruption—were to be verified locally on rank-linkage day and specially granted promotion without impediment."

sentences.zh: 建炎、紹興之間，排連、轉員屢嘗損益，而大率因於舊制。

translations.literal: Between the Jianyan and Shaoxing reigns, rank linkage and rank rotation were repeatedly modified, but mostly followed the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Jianyan and Shaoxing reigns rank linkage and rank rotation were repeatedly adjusted, yet mostly stayed within the old framework.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年，主管侍衛馬軍司公事李顯忠言：「本司諸兵將官有闕，自來擇眾所推者，不以次序上聞陞遷。

translations.literal: In Qiandao 6, Li Xianzhong, director of Palace Attendant Horse Army affairs, said: "When officer posts in this office were vacant, men popularly favored had traditionally been chosen and promoted out of order.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 6 Li Xianzhong, director of Palace Attendant Horse Army affairs, reported that when officer posts fell vacant his office had traditionally chosen popular favorites and reported them for promotion out of seniority order.

sentences.zh: 比年須自訓練官充準備將，準備將及二年陞副將，副將及二年陞正將，正將及三年陞統領官，再及三年陞統制官，竊恐無以激揚士氣。

translations.literal: In recent years one had to serve as training officer before reserve officer; after two years as reserve officer one rose to deputy officer, after two years as deputy to lead officer, after three years as lead to command officer, and after another three years to commander officer—I fear this cannot rouse morale.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years a man had to serve as training officer before reserve officer, reserve two years before deputy officer, deputy two years before lead officer, lead three years before command officer, and command three years before commander officer. I fear this cannot rouse morale.

sentences.zh: 請今後兵將官有闕，不以年為限，許本司銓量人材膽勇服眾上聞補用。

translations.literal: We request that henceforth when officer posts are vacant, without limit of years, this office be permitted to assess talent, courage, and popular command and report for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, when officer posts fall vacant, I ask that years no longer govern the choice and that this office be allowed to assess talent, courage, and command of the ranks and report men for appointment.

sentences.zh: 」詔從其請。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 此誠砥礪兵將之良法也。

translations.literal: This was truly a good method for honing military officers.
translations.idiomatic: This was truly a sound way to sharpen military officers.

sentences.zh: 嘉定中，樞密院言：

translations.literal: In the Jiading reign, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported:
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiading reign the Bureau of Military Affairs reported:

sentences.zh: 諸軍轉員遷補，務在均一。

translations.literal: Rank rotation and promotion in all armies should aim for uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: Rank rotation and promotion in all armies should aim at uniformity.

sentences.zh: 如內諸班直循舊格排連，積習既久，往往超躐陞轉，後名反居前列，高下不倫，甚失公平之意。

translations.literal: When inner platoons followed the old rules for rank linkage, long custom often produced leapfrog promotion; later names ended up ahead in line, high and low were unequal, and fairness was greatly lost.
translations.idiomatic: When inner platoons followed the old rank-linkage rules, long custom often produced leapfrog promotion: later appointees ended up ahead in line, rank and order no longer matched, and fairness was badly lost.

sentences.zh: 今參酌前後例格，均次資序：其一曰，內殿直左第一班副都知轉東西班西第二都知，內殿直左第二班副都知轉散直左班都知。

translations.literal: Now balancing past and present regulations, seniority is equalized as follows: First—Inner Palace Duty left first platoon deputy director rotates to East-West Platoon west second platoon director; Inner Palace Duty left second platoon deputy director rotates to Scattered Duty left platoon director.
translations.idiomatic: Balancing past and present regulations, seniority was equalized as follows. First: Inner Palace Duty left first platoon deputy director rotated to East-West Platoon west second platoon director; Inner Palace Duty left second platoon deputy director to Scattered Duty left platoon director.

sentences.zh: 其二曰，散員左第二班副都知陞內殿直左第一班副都知，散員右第一班副都知陞內殿直左第一班副都知。

translations.literal: Second—Irregular Attendant left second platoon deputy director is promoted to Inner Palace Duty left first platoon deputy director; Irregular Attendant right first platoon deputy director is promoted to Inner Palace Duty left first platoon deputy director.
translations.idiomatic: Second: Irregular Attendant left second platoon deputy director rose to Inner Palace Duty left first platoon deputy director; Irregular Attendant right first platoon deputy director likewise rose to Inner Palace Duty left first platoon deputy director.

sentences.zh: 其三曰，散員右第一班副都知陞內殿直右第一班副都知，散員左第二班副都知陞內殿直右第二班副都知。

translations.literal: Third—Irregular Attendant right first platoon deputy director is promoted to Inner Palace Duty right first platoon deputy director; Irregular Attendant left second platoon deputy director is promoted to Inner Palace Duty right second platoon deputy director.
translations.idiomatic: Third: Irregular Attendant right first platoon deputy director rose to Inner Palace Duty right first platoon deputy director; Irregular Attendant left second platoon deputy director to Inner Palace Duty right second platoon deputy director.

sentences.zh: 其四曰，散指揮左第一班副都知陞散員左第一班副都知，散指揮右第一班副都知陞散員右第一班副都知。

translations.literal: Fourth—Scattered Command left first platoon deputy director is promoted to Irregular Attendant left first platoon deputy director; Scattered Command right first platoon deputy director is promoted to Irregular Attendant right first platoon deputy director.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: Scattered Command left first platoon deputy director rose to Irregular Attendant left first platoon deputy director; Scattered Command right first platoon deputy director to Irregular Attendant right first platoon deputy director.

sentences.zh: 其五曰，散指揮左第二班副都知陞散員左第二班副都知，散指揮右第三班副都知陞右第二班副都知。

translations.literal: Fifth—Scattered Command left second platoon deputy director is promoted to Irregular Attendant left second platoon deputy director; Scattered Command right third platoon deputy director is promoted to right second platoon deputy director.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: Scattered Command left second platoon deputy director rose to Irregular Attendant left second platoon deputy director; Scattered Command right third platoon deputy director to right second platoon deputy director.

sentences.zh: 其六曰，散都頭左班副都知陞散指揮左第一班副都知，散都頭右班副都知陞散指揮右第一班都知。

translations.literal: Sixth—Scattered Squad Chief left platoon deputy director is promoted to Scattered Command left first platoon deputy director; Scattered Squad Chief right platoon deputy director is promoted to Scattered Command right first platoon director.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: Scattered Squad Chief left platoon deputy director rose to Scattered Command left first platoon deputy director; Scattered Squad Chief right platoon deputy director to Scattered Command right first platoon director.

sentences.zh: 其七曰，散祗候左班副都知陞散指揮左第一班副都知，散祗候右班副都知陞散指揮右第二班副都知。

translations.literal: Seventh—Scattered Attendant left platoon deputy director is promoted to Scattered Command left first platoon deputy director; Scattered Attendant right platoon deputy director is promoted to Scattered Command right second platoon deputy director.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: Scattered Attendant left platoon deputy director rose to Scattered Command left first platoon deputy director; Scattered Attendant right platoon deputy director to Scattered Command right second platoon deputy director.

sentences.zh: 其八曰，內殿直左第一班押班遷轉東西班西第一班副都知，內殿直右第一班押班轉東西班西第三班副都知。

translations.literal: Eighth—Inner Palace Duty left first platoon lead rotates to East-West Platoon west first platoon deputy director; Inner Palace Duty right first platoon lead rotates to East-West Platoon west third platoon deputy director.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: Inner Palace Duty left first platoon lead rotated to East-West Platoon west first platoon deputy director; Inner Palace Duty right first platoon lead to East-West Platoon west third platoon deputy director.

sentences.zh: 以上各係陞四名外，御龍直御龍左第一直十將轉御龍弓箭直副都頭，御龍直右第一直十將轉御龍弩直副都頭，御龍骨朵子直左第一直十將陞御龍左第一直十將，御龍弩直左第一直十將陞御龍弓箭左第三直十將，係各陞六名。

translations.literal: Apart from the above, each rising four ranks, Imperial Dragon platoon left first platoon squad sergeant of Imperial Dragon rotates to Imperial Dragon Bow platoon deputy squad chief; Imperial Dragon platoon right first platoon squad sergeant rotates to Imperial Dragon Crossbow platoon deputy squad chief; Imperial Dragon Mace platoon left first platoon squad sergeant is promoted to Imperial Dragon left first platoon squad sergeant; Imperial Dragon Crossbow platoon left first platoon squad sergeant is promoted to Imperial Dragon Bow left third platoon squad sergeant—each rising six ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond these, each rising four ranks: Imperial Dragon platoon left first platoon squad sergeant rotated to Imperial Dragon Bow platoon deputy squad chief; Imperial Dragon platoon right first platoon squad sergeant to Imperial Dragon Crossbow platoon deputy squad chief; Imperial Dragon Mace platoon left first platoon squad sergeant rose to Imperial Dragon left first platoon squad sergeant; Imperial Dragon Crossbow platoon left first platoon squad sergeant to Imperial Dragon Bow left third platoon squad sergeant—each rising six ranks.

sentences.zh: 於是超躐積習之弊盡革，而為定制焉。

translations.literal: Thus the abuse of leapfrog custom was fully reformed and fixed as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the abuse of leapfrog promotion was fully corrected and made fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 淳祐十一年，御史臺條奏軍功賞格違法之弊：「在法，邊戍獲捷、奇功、暴露、撤戍者，製閫、軍帥舉奏授官，必其人身親行陣，有戰禦功。

translations.literal: In Chunyou 11, the Censorate memorialized abuses of military merit reward regulations: "By law, for border victories, extraordinary merit, exposure in service, or withdrawal from garrison, frontier commanders and army chiefs memorialized for appointment only when the man himself had fought in the ranks with defensive merit.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunyou 11 the Censorate memorialized abuses in military merit rewards: "By law, when border garrisons won victories, achieved extraordinary merit, endured hardship in service, or withdrew from garrison, frontier commanders and army chiefs could memorialize for appointment only if the man had fought in the ranks with merit in defense.

sentences.zh: 今自守闕進勇副尉至承信郎、承節郎者，其弊尤多，乃以奉權要，酬私恩，或轉售於人。

translations.literal: Now from reserve Brave Deputy Captain through Credentialed Gentleman and Credentialed Officer the abuses are especially many—men do so to serve the powerful, repay private favors, or resell appointments to others.
translations.idiomatic: Now from reserve Brave Deputy Captain through Credentialed Gentleman and Credentialed Officer the abuses were worst: men bought favor with the powerful, repaid private debts, or resold appointments to others.

sentences.zh: 方等第功賞之初，即竄名其中，朝廷審核，動涉歲年，已無稽考。

translations.literal: At the very start of graded merit rewards they inserted false names; when the court reviewed, years often passed and nothing could be checked.
translations.idiomatic: At the very grading of merit rewards they inserted false names; by the time the court reviewed, years had passed and nothing could be checked.

sentences.zh: 甚至承受、廳吏、廝卒之流，足跡未嘗出都門，而沾親冒矢石、往來軍旅之恩，授以名器。

translations.literal: Even receivers, clerks, and runners whose feet had never left the capital gate received the grace meant for kin exposed to arrows and stones and service in the armies, and were given name and office.
translations.idiomatic: Even receivers, clerks, and runners whose feet had never left the capital gate shared the grace meant for kin under fire and men in the field, and received name and office.

sentences.zh: 請申嚴帥閫，令立功人親授告身，庶革冒濫。」

translations.literal: We request strict instruction to commanders that merit recipients personally receive appointment credentials, to reform abuse."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that commanders be strictly instructed to have merit recipients receive appointment credentials in person, to curb abuse."

sentences.zh: 寶祐五年，樞密院言：「應從軍職事，必立戰功，並隊伍中人曾經拍試武藝；

translations.literal: In Baoyou 5, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "For military service one must establish battle merit, and men in the unit must have passed martial selection tests;
translations.idiomatic: In Baoyou 5 the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that military service required established battle merit and that men in the unit must have passed martial selection tests;

sentences.zh: 若訓練官以遞而陞者，或年限未及仍帶『權』字，俟年及方陞正統制，此定法也。

translations.literal: if training officers rose in succession, or years were not yet complete and they still bore the word 'Acting,' they became full commanders only when years were complete—this is fixed law.
translations.idiomatic: training officers who rose in succession, or men whose years were incomplete and still bore the word 'Acting,' became full commanders only when their term was complete—this was fixed law.

sentences.zh: 近年任子、雜流冒授者，才無差遣，便請從軍，繇統領至總管，曾幾何時，超躐而進。

translations.literal: In recent years sons by privilege and miscellaneous appointees, once without assignment, immediately requested military service; from command officer to overall commander, in how little time they leapfrogged forward.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years sons by privilege and miscellaneous appointees, barely without assignment, immediately sought military posts; from command officer to overall commander they leapfrogged forward in no time.

sentences.zh: 甫得總管，卻恥軍職，輒稱私計不便，或托父母老疾，巧計離軍，又以筋力未衰，求差正任，甚非法意。」

translations.literal: Hardly made overall commander, they were ashamed of military office, then claimed private affairs inconvenient, or pleaded parents' age and illness, cunningly leaving the army, yet with strength undiminished sought regular civil appointment—greatly contrary to law."
translations.idiomatic: Hardly named overall commander, they were ashamed of military office, pleaded private inconvenience or parents' age and illness, cunningly left the army, then with strength undiminished sought regular civil appointment—greatly contrary to law."

sentences.zh: 至咸淳中，大將若呂文德、夏貴、孫虎臣、範文虎輩，矜功怙寵，慢上殘下，行伍功賞，視為己物，私其族姻故舊，俾戰士身膏於草莽，而奸人坐竊其勳爵矣。

translations.literal: By Xianchun, great generals such as Lu Wende, Xia Gui, Sun Huchen, and Fan Wenhua relied on merit and favored status, were disrespectful above and harsh below, treated rank-and-file merit rewards as their own property, favored kin and old friends, let warriors die in the grass while schemers sat and stole their honors and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: By Xianchun, great generals such as Lu Wende, Xia Gui, Sun Huchen, and Fan Wenhua traded on merit and imperial favor, were insolent to superiors and cruel to subordinates, treated rank-and-file merit rewards as private property, favored kin and old friends, let warriors die in the weeds while schemers sat and stole their honors and ranks.

sentences.zh: 屯戍之制

translations.literal: Regulations on Garrison Rotation
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on Garrison Rotation

sentences.zh: 凡遣上軍，軍頭司引對，賜以裝錢。

translations.literal: Whenever elite troops were dispatched, the Army Chiefs Office presented them for audience and granted outfit money.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever elite troops were dispatched, the Army Chiefs Office presented them for audience and granted outfit money.

sentences.zh: 代還，亦入見，犒以飲食，簡拔精銳，退其癃老。

translations.literal: On returning from replacement, they also entered audience; food and drink were provided in reward, the sharp were selected and the aged and infirm retired.
translations.idiomatic: When they returned from rotation they also entered audience, were feasted, the sharp were selected, and the aged and infirm sent home.

sentences.zh: 至於諸州禁、廂軍亦皆戍更，隸州者曰駐泊。

translations.literal: All forbidden and auxiliary armies in the prefectures also rotated garrison duty; those subordinate to a prefecture were called stationed garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Forbidden and auxiliary armies in the prefectures also rotated garrison duty; troops subordinate to a prefecture were called stationed garrison.

sentences.zh: 戍蜀將校，不遣都虞候，當行者易管他營。

translations.literal: For Sichuan garrison officers, adjutants were not dispatched; those due to go managed other camps.
translations.idiomatic: For Sichuan garrison officers, adjutants were not dispatched; men due to rotate managed other camps.

sentences.zh: 凡屯駐將校帶遙郡者，以客禮見長吏，餘如屯駐將校。

translations.literal: For all garrison officers holding distant prefectural commissions, they met senior officials as guests; the rest followed garrison officers.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison officers holding distant prefectural commissions met senior officials as guests; the rest followed ordinary garrison officers.

sentences.zh: 凡駐泊軍，若捍禦邊寇，即總管、鈐轄共議，州長吏等毋預。

translations.literal: For stationed garrison troops, if repelling border raiders, overall commander and supervisory commissioner deliberated jointly; prefectural officials did not participate.
translations.idiomatic: For stationed garrison troops repelling border raiders, overall commander and supervisory commissioner deliberated jointly without prefectural officials.

sentences.zh: 事涉本城，並屯駐在城兵馬，即知州、都監、監押同領。

translations.literal: If matters concerned the prefectural seat, together with garrison troops in the city, the prefect, garrison commander, and garrison supervisor jointly commanded.
translations.idiomatic: If matters concerned the prefectural seat, the prefect, garrison commander, and garrison supervisor jointly commanded together with garrison troops in the city.

sentences.zh: 若州與駐泊事相關者，公牒交報。

translations.literal: If prefecture and stationed garrison matters were related, they exchanged official dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: If prefecture and stationed garrison matters were related, they exchanged official dispatches.

sentences.zh: 凡戍更有程：京東西、河北、河東、陝西、江、淮、兩浙、荊湖、川峽、廣南東路三年，廣南西路二年，陝西城砦巡檢並將領下兵半年。

translations.literal: Garrison rotation had fixed terms: Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, Jianghuai, Liangzhe, Jinghu, Chuanxia, and Guangnan East Circuit three years; Guangnan West Circuit two years; Shaanxi fort and patrol inspectors and officers' troops half a year.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison rotation had fixed terms: three years in Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, Jianghuai, Liangzhe, Jinghu, Chuanxia, and Guangnan East Circuit; two years in Guangnan West Circuit; half a year for Shaanxi fort and patrol inspectors and officers' troops.

sentences.zh: 景祐元，詔：「若聞陝西戍卒，多為大將選置麾下，及偏裨臨陣，鮮得精銳自隨。

translations.literal: In Jingyou 1, an edict ordered: "If it is heard that Shaanxi garrison soldiers are mostly chosen by great generals and placed under their personal command, when deputies face battle they rarely have sharp troops with them.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyou 1 an edict noted that Shaanxi garrison soldiers were mostly chosen by great generals and kept under personal command, so when deputies faced battle they rarely had sharp troops with them.

sentences.zh: 自今以全軍隸逐將，毋得選占。

translations.literal: Henceforth whole armies are subordinate to each commander; selection and seizure are forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth whole armies are to follow each commander; personal selection and seizure are forbidden."

sentences.zh: 」三年，詔廣、桂、荊、潭、鼎、澧六州各置雄略一營，與歸遠軍更戍嶺外。

translations.literal: In year 3, an edict ordered that Guang, Gui, Jing, Tan, Ding, and Li six prefectures each establish one Heroic Strategy camp, rotating with the Return Far Army to garrison beyond the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 an edict ordered Guang, Gui, Jing, Tan, Ding, and Li six prefectures each to establish one Heroic Strategy camp, rotating with the Return Far Army to garrison beyond the ranges.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，頒銅符、木契、傳信牌。

translations.literal: In Kangding 1, bronze tally tokens, wooden contracts, and message-passing plaques were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangding 1 bronze tally tokens, wooden contracts, and message-passing plaques were issued.

sentences.zh: 銅符上篆刻曰「某處發兵符」，下鑄虎豹為飾，而中分之。

translations.literal: The bronze tally was engraved above with "Troop-dispatch tally of such-and-such place," cast below with tiger and leopard ornament, and split down the middle.
translations.idiomatic: Each bronze tally was engraved above with "Troop-dispatch tally of such-and-such place," cast below with tiger-and-leopard ornament, and split down the middle.

sentences.zh: 右符五，左旁作虎豹頭四；

translations.literal: The right tally had five pieces; on the left side were four tiger-leopard heads;
translations.idiomatic: The right tally had five pieces; on the left side were four tiger-leopard heads;

sentences.zh: 左符五，右旁為四竅，令可勘合。

translations.literal: the left tally had five pieces; on the right side were four sockets so they could be matched.
translations.idiomatic: the left tally had five pieces; on the right side were four sockets so they could be matched.

sentences.zh: 又以篆文相向側刻十幹字為號：一甲己，二乙庚，三丙辛，四丁壬，五戊癸。

translations.literal: The ten heavenly stems were also carved facing each other as serial numbers: one jia-ji, two yi-geng, three bing-xin, four ding-ren, five wu-gui.
translations.idiomatic: The ten heavenly stems were carved facing each other as serial numbers: one jia-ji, two yi-geng, three bing-xin, four ding-ren, five wu-gui.

sentences.zh: 左符刻十幹半字，右符止刻甲己等兩半字。

translations.literal: The left tally carved half of each stem character; the right tally carved only the two half-characters of jia-ji and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: The left tally carved half of each stem character; the right tally carved only the two half-characters of jia-ji and the rest.

sentences.zh: 右五符留京師，左符降總管、鈐轄、知州軍官高者掌之。

translations.literal: The five right tallies remained in the capital; the left tallies were issued to overall commanders, supervisory commissioners, and the senior prefectural or garrison official to hold.
translations.idiomatic: The five right tallies remained in the capital; the left tallies went to overall commanders, supervisory commissioners, and the senior prefectural or garrison official.

sentences.zh: 凡發兵，樞密院下符一至五，周而復始。

translations.literal: Whenever troops were dispatched, the Bureau of Military Affairs issued tallies one through five in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever troops were dispatched, the Bureau of Military Affairs issued tallies one through five in rotation.

sentences.zh: 指揮三百人至五千人用一虎一豹符，五千人已上用雙虎豹符。

translations.literal: For three hundred to five thousand men one tiger and one leopard tally was used; for five thousand and above, double tiger-leopard tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch of three hundred to five thousand men used one tiger and one leopard tally; five thousand or more required double tiger-leopard tallies.

sentences.zh: 樞密院下符以右符第一為始，內匣中，緘印之，命使者齎宣同下，雲下第一符，發兵與使者，復緘右符以還，仍疾置聞。

translations.literal: The Bureau issued tallies beginning with the first right tally, sealed in an inner case, sent an envoy with the edict together; the first tally below the clouds was issued to troops with the envoy; the right tally was resealed and returned, and express relay reported.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau issued tallies beginning with the first right tally, sealed in an inner case, and sent an envoy with the edict. The first tally below the clouds went to the troops with the envoy; the right tally was resealed and returned, and express relay reported back.

sentences.zh: 所在籍下符資次日月及兵數，毋得付所司。

translations.literal: The locality registered date and troop count of each tally received and did not hand them to subordinate offices.
translations.idiomatic: The locality registered the date and troop count of each tally received and did not hand them to subordinate offices.

sentences.zh: 其木契上下題「某處契」，中剖之，上三枚中為魚形，題「一、二、三」，下一枚中刻空魚，令可勘合，左旁題云「左魚合」，右旁題云「右魚合」。

translations.literal: The wooden contract was inscribed above and below with "Contract of such-and-such place," split down the middle; the upper three pieces had fish shapes in the center inscribed "one, two, three"; the lower piece had an empty fish cut so they could be matched; on the left was inscribed "left fish match," on the right "right fish match."
translations.idiomatic: The wooden contract was inscribed above and below with "Contract of such-and-such place" and split down the middle. The upper three pieces bore fish shapes in the center marked "one, two, three"; the lower piece bore an empty fish cut for matching; the left was marked "left fish match," the right "right fish match."

sentences.zh: 上三枚留總管、鈐轄官高者掌之，下一枚付諸州軍城砦主掌之。

translations.literal: The upper three pieces were kept by the senior overall commander or supervisory commissioner; the lower piece was given to the prefecture, garrison, or fort commander to hold.
translations.idiomatic: The upper three pieces were kept by the senior overall commander or supervisory commissioner; the lower piece went to the prefecture, garrison, or fort commander.

sentences.zh: 總管、鈐轄發兵馬，百人已上，先發上契第一枚，貯以韋囊，緘印之，遣指揮齎牒同往。

translations.literal: When overall commander or supervisory commissioner dispatched troops of one hundred or more, first the upper contract first piece was sent, stored in a leather pouch, sealed, and an officer sent with a dispatch together.
translations.idiomatic: When an overall commander or supervisory commissioner dispatched one hundred men or more, he first sent the upper contract's first piece in a sealed leather pouch with an officer and dispatch.

sentences.zh: 所在驗下契與上契合，即發兵，復緘上契以還，仍報總管、鈐轄。

translations.literal: The locality verified that the lower contract matched the upper and then dispatched troops; the upper contract was resealed and returned, and overall commander and supervisory commissioner were reported.
translations.idiomatic: The locality verified that the lower contract matched the upper, then dispatched troops; the upper contract was resealed and returned, and the overall commander and supervisory commissioner were notified.

sentences.zh: 其發第二、第三契亦如之。

translations.literal: Dispatch of the second and third contracts followed the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch of the second and third contracts followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 掌契官籍發契資次日月及兵數以為驗。

translations.literal: The contract-holding officer registered date and troop count of each contract issued as verification.
translations.idiomatic: The contract-holding officer registered the date and troop count of each contract issued as verification.

sentences.zh: 傳信牌中為池槽，藏筆墨紙，令主將掌之。

translations.literal: The message-passing plaque had a pool-trough in the center holding brush, ink, and paper, for the commanding general to hold.
translations.idiomatic: The message-passing plaque had a pool-trough in the center holding brush, ink, and paper, for the commanding general to hold.

sentences.zh: 每臨陣傳命，書紙內牌中，持報兵官，復書事宜內牌中而還。

translations.literal: Whenever orders were passed on the battlefield, writing was placed inside the plaque and sent to military officers; affairs completed were written inside the plaque and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever orders were passed on the battlefield, writing went inside the plaque to military officers; completed business was written inside the plaque and returned.

sentences.zh: 主將密以字為號驗，毋得漏泄軍中事。

translations.literal: The commanding general secretly used characters as verification codes; military affairs must not leak.
translations.idiomatic: The commanding general secretly used characters as verification codes; military affairs must not leak.

sentences.zh: 呂夷簡言：「自元昊反，被邊城砦各為自守計，萬一賊有奔衝，即關輔驚擾。

translations.literal: Lu Yijian said: "Since Yuanhao rebelled, each border fort and camp made its own plan to hold fast; if the enemy should break through in a rush, the capital region would be alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yijian said: "Since Yuanhao rebelled, each border fort and camp had made its own plan to hold fast. If the enemy broke through in a rush, the capital region would be thrown into alarm.

sentences.zh: 雖夏竦等屯永興，其實兵少。

translations.literal: Although Xia Song and others were garrisoned at Yongxing, in fact the troops were few.
translations.idiomatic: Although Xia Song and others garrisoned Yongxing, they had few troops in fact.

sentences.zh: 自永興距鄜延、環慶諸路，皆數百里，設有急緩，內外不能相救。

translations.literal: From Yongxing to Fuyan, Huanqing, and other routes all were several hundred li; if urgency arose, inner and outer could not rescue each other.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongxing to Fuyan, Huanqing, and other routes was several hundred li; in an emergency inner and outer forces could not rescue each other.

sentences.zh: 請募勇敢士三萬，訓以武技，分置十隊，以有謀勇者三人將之，分營永興。

translations.literal: We request recruiting thirty thousand brave men, training them in martial skill, dividing them into ten companies under three men of counsel and courage as commanders, and encamping them separately at Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: I request recruiting thirty thousand brave men, training them in martial skill, dividing them into ten companies under three men of counsel and courage as commanders, and encamping them separately at Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 西寇至，則舉烽相應，或乘勢討擊，進退不以地分，並受夏竦等節制。

translations.literal: When western bandits arrived, they would raise beacon fires in response to one another, or take advantage of the moment to pursue and strike; advance and retreat would not be divided by territory, and all would fall under the command of Xia Song and others.
translations.idiomatic: When western raiders appeared, the companies would raise beacon fires in mutual response or strike while the enemy was exposed; advance and retreat would not be bound by territorial lines, and all would answer to Xia Song and his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 初，趙元昊反，以夏竦、陳執中知永興軍，節度陝西諸軍，久之無功。

translations.literal: Initially, when Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, Xia Song and Chen Zhizhong were made military commissioners of Yongxing and given overall command of the Shaanxi armies, but after a long time they achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Yuanhao first rebelled, Xia Song and Chen Zhizhong were put in charge of Yongxing and given command of all Shaanxi forces, yet after a long campaign they had nothing to show for it.

sentences.zh: 乃析秦鳳、涇原、環慶、鄜延為四路，以秦、渭、慶、延知州分領本路馬步軍。

translations.literal: They then divided Qinfeng, Jingyuan, Huanqing, and Fuyan into four circuits, with the prefects of Qin, Wei, Qing, and Yan each commanding the horse and foot armies of their circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The court then split Qinfeng, Jingyuan, Huanqing, and Fuyan into four circuits, with the prefects of Qin, Wei, Qing, and Yan each taking command of the horse and foot armies on their route.

sentences.zh: 是歲，罷銅符、木契。

translations.literal: That year, bronze tally tokens and wooden contracts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That year the bronze tally tokens and wooden contracts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「陝西屯重兵，罄本路租稅，益以內庫錢帛，並西川歲輸，而軍儲猶不足。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Shaanxi garrisons heavy troops, exhausts the circuit's land tax, supplements with Inner Treasury funds and cloth, plus Sichuan's annual tribute, yet military stores are still insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Shaanxi kept a massive garrison, draining the circuit's land tax and supplementing it with Inner Treasury funds and cloth plus Sichuan's annual tribute—yet military stores were still not enough.

sentences.zh: 宜度隙地為營田務，四路總管、轉運悉兼領使。」

translations.literal: Idle land should be surveyed for military colony offices; the overall commanders and transport commissioners of all four circuits are all to serve concurrently as commissioners."
translations.idiomatic: Idle land should be surveyed for military colony offices, and the overall commanders and transport commissioners of all four circuits should concurrently head those offices."

sentences.zh: 慶曆二年，詔：「已發士三萬戍永興，委總管司部分閱教。

translations.literal: In Qingli 2, an edict said: "Thirty thousand troops have already been sent to garrison Yongxing; the overall commander's office is charged with partial review and training.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 2 an edict ordered that the thirty thousand troops already sent to garrison Yongxing be reviewed and trained in sections by the overall commander's office.

sentences.zh: 歲以八月遣萬五千人戍涇、原、儀、渭州、鎮戎軍，十二月以萬五千人代，至二月無警即還，歲以為常。

translations.literal: Each year in the eighth month fifteen thousand men are sent to garrison Jing, Yuan, Yi, Wei prefectures and Zhenrong Army; in the twelfth month fifteen thousand relieve them; if no alarm by the second month they return—this became the annual rule."
translations.idiomatic: Each year fifteen thousand men would garrison Jing, Yuan, Yi, Wei, and Zhenrong in the eighth month and be relieved by another fifteen thousand in the twelfth; if no alarm arose by the second month they returned home—a standing annual rotation.

sentences.zh: 」葛懷敏等喪師，命范仲淹、韓琦、龐籍復統四路，軍期中覆不及者，以便宜從事。

translations.literal: After Ge Huaimin and others lost their army, Fan Zhongyan, Han Qi, and Pang Ji were ordered to resume command of the four circuits; where military deadlines could not await imperial reply, they were to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: After Ge Huaimin and others lost their army, Fan Zhongyan, Han Qi, and Pang Ji were restored to command of the four circuits, with discretion to act when military deadlines could not wait on the court.

sentences.zh: 四年，夏人已納款，乃罷。

translations.literal: In year 4 the Tangut had submitted, and the arrangement was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 the Tangut submitted, and the arrangement was abolished.

sentences.zh: 四月，帝謂輔臣曰：「湖廣擊蠻吏士，方夏瘴熱，而罹疾者眾，宜遣醫往為胗視。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month the emperor told his chief ministers: "Officials and soldiers fighting the Yao in Huguang face midsummer miasma and heat, and many have fallen ill; physicians should be sent to examine them."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the emperor told his chief ministers that officials and soldiers fighting the Yao in Huguang were falling ill in midsummer heat and miasma, and that physicians should be sent to examine them.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔：「騎軍以盛夏出戍，馬多道死。

translations.literal: In year 6 an edict said: "When cavalry is dispatched to garrison in midsummer, many horses die on the road.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 an edict noted that when cavalry was sent out to garrison in midsummer, many horses died on the road.

sentences.zh: 自今以八月至二月遣發。

translations.literal: From now on dispatch from the eighth month through the second month."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth dispatch should run from the eighth month through the second month."

sentences.zh: 」又詔：「廣南方春瘴癘，戍兵在邊者權休善地。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "In early spring miasma reigns in Guangnan; garrison troops on the frontier are temporarily to rest in healthier regions.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that because early-spring miasma afflicted Guangnan, frontier garrison troops were temporarily to rest in healthier country.

sentences.zh: 其自嶺外戍回軍士，予休兩月。

translations.literal: Soldiers returning from garrison beyond the ranges receive two months' rest."
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers returning from garrison beyond the ranges were granted two months' rest."

sentences.zh: 」李昭亮上言：「舊制，調發諸軍先引見，試以戰陣，遷補校長。

translations.literal: Li Zhaoliang memorialized: "Under the old system, before dispatching armies they were first presented for audience, tested in battle formation, and squad leaders were promoted and filled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhaoliang memorialized that under the old system, before armies were dispatched they were presented to the throne, tested in battle formation, and squad leaders were promoted and appointed.

sentences.zh: 今或不暇試戰陣，請選強壯有武技者，每十人引見轉資後遣。

translations.literal: Now when there is no time to test battle formation, please select strong men with martial skill, present every ten for audience after rank rotation, then dispatch."
translations.idiomatic: When there was no time for battle tests, he asked that strong men with proven martial skill be chosen, that every ten be presented for audience after rank rotation, and then dispatched.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 時契丹使來議關南地，朝廷經制河北武備，議者欲增兵屯。

translations.literal: At the time Khitan envoys came to negotiate the Guannan territory; the court was organizing Hebei's military preparedness, and advocates wished to increase garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Khitan envoys came to negotiate the Guannan territories, and as the court reorganized Hebei's defenses, some officials urged larger garrisons.

sentences.zh: 程琳自大名府徙安撫陝西，上言曰：「河朔地方數千里，連城三十六，民物繁庶，川原坦平。

translations.literal: Cheng Lin was transferred from Daming Prefecture to pacification commissioner of Shaanxi and memorialized: "The Yellow River north spans several thousand li, with thirty-six linked cities, abundant population and goods, and level plains.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Lin, transferred from Daming Prefecture to pacification commissioner of Shaanxi, memorialized that the Yellow River north stretched thousands of li across thirty-six linked cities, with abundant people and goods on level plains.

sentences.zh: 自景德以前，邊數有警，官軍雖眾，罕有成功。

translations.literal: Before Jingde there were repeated border alarms; though government troops were numerous, success was rare.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Jingde era the border had alarm after alarm, yet for all their numbers government troops rarely won.

sentences.zh: 蓋定州、真定府、高陽關三路之兵，形勢不接，召發之際，交錯非便。

translations.literal: Because the armies of Dingzhou, Zhen Ding Prefecture, and Gaoyang Pass three routes did not connect in deployment, when mobilizing they crossed awkwardly.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of Dingzhou, Zhen Ding Prefecture, and Gaoyang Pass did not connect in deployment, so mobilization sent them crisscrossing one another to little effect.

sentences.zh: 況建全魏以製北方，而兵隸定州、真定府路，其勢倒置。

translations.literal: Moreover Wei was built whole to check the north, yet troops belonged to Dingzhou and Zhen Ding Prefecture routes—the disposition was inverted.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Wei had been built whole to check the north, yet its troops belonged to the Dingzhou and Zhen Ding routes—the military balance was upside down.

sentences.zh: 請以河朔兵為四路，以鎮、定十州軍為一路，合兵十萬人；

translations.literal: I request dividing Yellow River north troops into four routes: the ten prefectures and armies of Zhen and Ding as one route, totaling one hundred thousand men;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dividing Yellow River north troops into four routes: the ten prefectures and armies of Zhen and Ding as one route, totaling one hundred thousand men;

sentences.zh: 高陽關十一州軍為一路，合兵八萬人；

translations.literal: eleven prefectures and armies of Gaoyang Pass as one route, totaling eighty thousand men;
translations.idiomatic: eleven prefectures and armies of Gaoyang Pass as one route, totaling eighty thousand men;

sentences.zh: 滄、霸七州軍為一路，合兵四萬人；

translations.literal: Cang and Ba seven prefectures and armies as one route, totaling forty thousand men;
translations.idiomatic: Cang and Ba seven prefectures and armies as one route, totaling forty thousand men;

sentences.zh: 北京九州軍為一路，合兵八萬人。

translations.literal: Northern Capital nine prefectures and armies as one route, totaling eighty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital nine prefectures and armies as one route, totaling eighty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 其駐泊鈐轄、都監各掌訓練，使士卒習聞主將號令，急緩即成部分。」

translations.literal: The stationed supervisory commissioners and garrison supervisors each manage training, so soldiers learn their commanding general's orders and can form units at urgency or leisure."
translations.idiomatic: Stationed supervisory commissioners and garrison supervisors would train the men until they knew their commander's orders by heart and could deploy at a moment's notice."

sentences.zh: 天子下其章，判大名府夏竦奏：「鎮、定二路當內外之衝，萬一有警，各籍重兵，控守要害，迭為應援。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven forwarded his memorial; Xia Song, administering Daming Prefecture, memorialized: "The Zhen and Ding two routes lie at the inner-outer junction; should alarm arise, each keeps heavy troops, controls key points, and alternates in mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor forwarded the memorial. Xia Song, administering Daming Prefecture, replied that the Zhen and Ding routes stood at the inner-outer junction; in an emergency each should keep heavy troops on the key points and alternate in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 若合為一，則兵柄太重，減之則不足以備敵。

translations.literal: If merged into one, military authority would be too heavy; if reduced, it would not suffice against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Merge them and military authority would be too concentrated; cut them and they would not suffice against the enemy.

sentences.zh: 又滄州久隸高陽關，道里頗近，瀕海斥鹵，地形沮洳，東北三百里，野無民居，非賊蹊徑。

translations.literal: Moreover Cangzhou long belonged to Gaoyang Pass, the distance is quite close, the coast is saline, the terrain boggy, and for three hundred li to the northeast there are no dwellings in the wild—it is no enemy path.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Cangzhou had long belonged to Gaoyang Pass. The coast was saline, the ground boggy, and for three hundred li to the northeast there was no habitation—it was no enemy avenue.

sentences.zh: 萬一有警，可決漳、御河東灌，塘澱隔越，賊兵未易奔衝，不必別建一路。

translations.literal: Should alarm arise, the Zhang and Imperial rivers can be opened to flood eastward; ponds and marshlands block passage, and enemy troops cannot easily break through—there is no need for a separate route.
translations.idiomatic: In an emergency the Zhang and Imperial rivers could be opened to flood the east; ponds and marshlands would block passage, and enemy troops could not easily break through—there was no need for a separate route.

sentences.zh: 惟北京為河朔根本，宜宿重兵，控扼大河南北，內則屏蔽王畿，外則聲援諸路。

translations.literal: Only the Northern Capital is the Yellow River north's foundation; heavy troops should be stationed to command the Great River north and south, shielding the imperial region within and supporting all routes without.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Northern Capital was the foundation of the Yellow River north. Heavy troops there could command the river north and south, shield the capital within, and support every route without.

sentences.zh: 請以大名府、澶、懷、衛、濱、棣、德、博州、通利軍建為北京路。

translations.literal: I request establishing Daming Prefecture, Chan, Huai, Wei, Bin, Di, De, Bo prefectures, and Tongli Army as the Northern Capital Route.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed establishing Daming Prefecture, Chan, Huai, Wei, Bin, Di, De, Bo, and Tongli Army as the Northern Capital Route.

sentences.zh: 四路各置都總管、副都總管一人，鈐轄二人，都監四人。

translations.literal: Each of the four routes should have one overall commander and one deputy overall commander, two supervisory commissioners, and four garrison supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the four routes should have one overall commander and one deputy, two supervisory commissioners, and four garrison supervisors.

sentences.zh: 平時只以河北安撫使總製諸路，有警，即北京置四路行營都總管，擇嘗任兩府重臣為之。」

translations.literal: In peacetime the Hebei pacification commissioner alone governs all routes; at alarm, place a four-route campaign overall commander at the Northern Capital, choosing a former grand councillor who served both bureaus."
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime the Hebei pacification commissioner would govern all routes; in an emergency a four-route campaign overall commander would be posted at the Northern Capital, chosen from a former grand councillor of both bureaus."

sentences.zh: 議未決，竦入為樞密使，賈昌朝判大名府，復命規度。

translations.literal: The discussion was unresolved; Xia Song entered office as Bureau of Military Affairs chief, Jia Changchao was assigned Daming Prefecture, and they were again ordered to survey and plan.
translations.idiomatic: Before the debate was settled, Xia Song entered the Bureau of Military Affairs and Jia Changchao was assigned Daming Prefecture; both were ordered to survey the plan again.

sentences.zh: 昌朝請如竦議，惟保州沿邊巡檢並雄、霸、滄州界河二司兵馬，國初以來，拓邊最號強勁，今未有所隸，請立沿邊巡檢司隸定州路，界河司隸高陽關路。

translations.literal: Changchao requested following Xia Song's plan, except that border patrol inspectors of Baozhou and the two Border River offices of Xiong, Ba, and Cang—the strongest border expansion troops since the dynasty's founding, now without a master—should have a Border Patrol Office under Dingzhou Route and a Border River Office under Gaoyang Pass Route.
translations.idiomatic: Changchao endorsed Xia Song's plan, but asked that Baozhou's border patrol inspectors and the two Border River offices of Xiong, Ba, and Cang—the strongest frontier troops since the founding, now unassigned—be placed under a Border Patrol Office on the Dingzhou Route and a Border River Office on the Gaoyang Pass Route.

sentences.zh: 於是下詔分河北兵為四路：北京、澶、懷、衛、德、博、濱、棣州、通利保、順軍合為大名府路；

translations.literal: An edict then divided Hebei troops into four routes: Northern Capital, Chan, Huai, Wei, De, Bo, Bin, Di prefectures, Tongli, Bao, and Shun armies combined as Daming Prefecture Route;
translations.idiomatic: An edict then divided Hebei troops into four routes: the Northern Capital, Chan, Huai, Wei, De, Bo, Bin, and Di prefectures plus Tongli, Bao, and Shun armies became the Daming Prefecture Route;

sentences.zh: 瀛、莫、雄、霸、貝、冀、滄州、永靜、乾寧、保定、信安軍合為高陽關路；

translations.literal: Ying, Mo, Xiong, Ba, Bei, Ji, Cang prefectures, Yongjing, Qianning, Baoding, and Xin'an armies combined as Gaoyang Pass Route;
translations.idiomatic: Ying, Mo, Xiong, Ba, Bei, Ji, and Cang prefectures plus Yongjing, Qianning, Baoding, and Xin'an armies became the Gaoyang Pass Route;

sentences.zh: 鎮、邢、洺、相、趙、磁州合為真定府路；

translations.literal: Zhen, Xing, Ming, Xiang, Zhao, and Ci prefectures combined as Zhen Ding Prefecture Route;
translations.idiomatic: Zhen, Xing, Ming, Xiang, Zhao, and Ci prefectures became the Zhen Ding Prefecture Route;

sentences.zh: 定、保、深、祁州、北平、廣信、安肅、順安、永寧軍合為定州路。

translations.literal: Ding, Bao, Shen, and Qi prefectures, Beiping, Guangxin, Ansu, Shun'an, and Yongning armies combined as Dingzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: Ding, Bao, Shen, and Qi prefectures plus Beiping, Guangxin, Ansu, Shun'an, and Yongning armies became the Dingzhou Route.

sentences.zh: 凡兵屯將領，悉如其議。

translations.literal: All troop deployments and commanders followed the proposal entirely.
translations.idiomatic: All troop deployments and commanders followed the plan.

sentences.zh: 韓琦謂兵勢大分，請合定州、真定府為一，高陽關、大名府為一。

translations.literal: Han Qi said the military disposition was too divided and requested merging Dingzhou and Zhen Ding Prefecture into one, and Gaoyang Pass and Daming Prefecture into one.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi argued that the forces were too scattered and asked to merge Dingzhou with Zhen Ding Prefecture and Gaoyang Pass with Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以更寘甫新，不報。

translations.literal: The court, because the new arrangement had just been put in place, did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: The court, having just put the new arrangement in place, did not reply.

sentences.zh: 詔四路兵依陝西遣部將往來按閱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the four routes' troops, following the Shaanxi model, to send staff officers back and forth for inspection tours.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the four routes, following the Shaanxi model, to send staff officers back and forth on inspection tours.

sentences.zh: 又詔自今兵戍回，揀充捧日、龍衛、天武、神衛等軍。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that from now on, troops returning from garrison rotation were to be selected to fill Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Heavenly Martial, Divine Guard, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that troops returning from garrison rotation be selected to fill the Sun-Bearing, Dragon Guard, Heavenly Martial, Divine Guard, and other Palace Guard armies.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年，發禁兵十指揮戍京東，以歲饑備盜。

translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that with Shaanxi border alarms quiet, local troops could handle defense, and East Army garrison troops were moved to inner prefectures to save supplies.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔：「如聞河北諸屯將校，有老疾廢事而不知退，有善部勒著勞效而不得進，帥臣、監司審察，密以名聞。」

translations.idiomatic: In year 2 an edict reported that some Hebei garrison officers were aged, ill, and useless yet refused to retire, while others commanded well with proven merit yet could not advance; circuit commanders and supervisory commissioners were to investigate and report names in secret.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「戍兵歲滿，有司按籍，遠者前二月，近者前一月遣代，戍還本管聽休。

translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict ordered that when garrison troops completed their term, the responsible office check registers and dispatch replacements two months ahead for distant posts and one month for near ones; returning garrison troops were to rest at their home command.

sentences.zh: 」五年，又詔：「廣西戍兵及二年而未得代者罷歸，鈐轄司以土兵歲一代之。

translations.idiomatic: In year 5 another edict ordered that Guangxi garrison troops who had served two years without relief be sent home, with the supervisory commissioner's office sending local troops annually to replace them.

sentences.zh: 」自儂智高之亂，戍兵逾二萬四千，至是聽還，而令土兵代戍。

translations.literal: Since Nong Zhigao's rebellion garrison troops had exceeded twenty-four thousand; now they were permitted to return and local troops were ordered to replace them in garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Since Nong Zhigao's rebellion garrison troops had exceeded twenty-four thousand; now they were permitted to return home and local troops were ordered to take over the garrisons.

sentences.zh: 自今歲滿，以江、淮教閱忠節、威果代之。」

translations.idiomatic: Early in Xining he once discussed Hebei defenses with his chief ministers.

translations.idiomatic: The frontier therefore had no runaway expense; strengthening the root and weakening the branches, the disposition was sound.

translations.idiomatic: That year an edict moved Hezhou horse troops to Xizhou and Xizhou horse troops to Tongyuan Army so they could be summoned quickly and frontier stores saved.

translations.idiomatic: In year 9 an edict noted that the capital kept one hundred thousand troops while the rest supplied garrisons everywhere—a number greatly diminished.

translations.idiomatic: For the three frontier circuits whole or half regiments were sent; other circuits could divide by whole companies, but not beyond half a regiment."

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that the southeast's thirteen regiments had never had garrison assignments equalized since regiment command was established, and that some non-regiment troops with few quota slots were sending too many companies—the burden was uneven.

sentences.zh: 欲除廣南東、西兩路駐紮三將只充本路守禦差使，虔州第六將、全、永州第九將準備廣南東、西路緩急勾抽策應，並不差戍他路外，餘八將及不隸將兵依均定路分都鈐轄司駐泊，分擘差使。

translations.idiomatic: It proposed that except for three regiments in Guangnan East and West serving only local defense, and the sixth at Qianzhou and ninth at Quan and Yongzhou held ready for Guangnan emergencies—all exempt from rotating elsewhere—the remaining eight regiments and non-regiment troops divide duties by equalized assignment at supervisory commissioner stations.
