translations.literal: That month an edict said: "The Hedong Circuit overall commander's office should flexibly redeploy and replace upper-rotation horse and troops, not letting border garrison last so long as to cause exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered the Hedong Circuit overall commander's office to flexibly redeploy and rotate upper-rotation horse and troops, lest long border service bring exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 如無人替換，候春月事宜稍息，即先後上番四將抽減一番兵馬歸營。」

translations.literal: If there is no one to replace them, when spring arrives and affairs have quieted somewhat, then in sequence from the four upper-rotation regiments draw down one rotation of horse and troops to return to camp."
translations.idiomatic: If no replacements were available, when spring came and affairs had quieted, the four upper-rotation regiments were to draw down one rotation of horse and troops in sequence and return them to camp."

sentences.zh: 元符二年閏九月，遣秦鳳戍兵十指揮應副熙河新邊戍守。

translations.literal: In Yuanfu 2, intercalary ninth month, ten Qinfeng garrison companies were dispatched to support the new Xihe frontier garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month of Yuanfu 2, ten Qinfeng garrison companies were dispatched to support defense of the new Xihe frontier.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以呂惠卿奏，減鄜延戍兵五十指揮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on Lü Huiqing's memorial, fifty Fuyan garrison companies were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on Lü Huiqing's memorial, Fuyan garrison troops were reduced by fifty companies.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，詔遣虎翼軍六千戍熙河路，令代蕃兵及弓箭手還家休息。

translations.literal: In year 3, eighth month, an edict dispatched six thousand Tiger Wing troops to garrison Xihe Circuit, replacing fan militia and archer militia so they could return home and rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 3, an edict dispatched six thousand Tiger Wing troops to garrison Xihe Circuit, relieving fan militia and archer militia to return home and rest.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔邊帥減額外戍兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered frontier commanders to reduce excess garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered frontier commanders to cut excess garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 崇寧四年，詔：「廣南瘴癘之鄉，東西雖殊，氣候無異。

translations.literal: In Chongning 4 an edict said: "Guangnan is a land of miasma; though east and west differ, the climate is the same.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongning 4 an edict noted that Guangnan was a land of miasma; though east and west differed, the climate was the same.

sentences.zh: 西路戍兵二年一代，而東路獨限三年，代不如期，有隕於瘴癘者，朕甚惻然。

translations.literal: Western route garrison troops rotate every two years, but the eastern route alone is limited to three years; when relief does not come on schedule, some fall to miasma—I am deeply pained.
translations.idiomatic: Western route garrison troops rotated every two years, but the eastern route alone was limited to three; when relief did not come on schedule, some fell to miasma—the emperor was deeply pained.

sentences.zh: 其東路亦令二年一替，前期半年差人，如違，以違制論。」

translations.literal: The eastern route too is ordered to rotate every two years, dispatching relief six months in advance; violations are punished as violations of regulations."
translations.idiomatic: The eastern route too was ordered to rotate every two years, with relief dispatched six months in advance; violations would be punished as breaches of regulations."

sentences.zh: 大觀二年六月，詔：「陝西諸路，自罷兵以來，數年於此，兵未曾徹。

translations.literal: In Daguan 2, sixth month, an edict said: "In the Shaanxi circuits, since the ceasefire several years have passed, yet troops have never been withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Daguan 2 an edict noted that in the Shaanxi circuits, several years had passed since the ceasefire, yet troops had never been withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 蓋緣邊將怯懦，坐費邊儲，戍卒勞苦。

translations.literal: This is because frontier generals are cowardly, idly wasting frontier stores while garrison soldiers suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier generals had grown cowardly, idly draining frontier stores while garrison soldiers endured hardship.

sentences.zh: 可除新邊的確人外，餘並依元豐罷邊事日戍額人數外，餘並直抽歸營。

translations.literal: Except for definite-post men on the new frontier, the rest beyond the Yuanfeng ceasefire-day garrison quota should all be directly drawn back to camp.
translations.idiomatic: Except for men at designated posts on the new frontier, all troops beyond the Yuanfeng ceasefire-day garrison quota were to be drawn straight back to camp.

sentences.zh: 有司不得占吝，如違，以違制論。

translations.literal: Responsible offices may not hoard them; violations are punished as violations of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Responsible offices were forbidden to hoard them; violations would be punished as breaches of regulations.

sentences.zh: 」又詔：「東南除見兵額外，帥府別屯二千人，望郡一千人。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "In the southeast, beyond the current troop quota, command prefectures should station two thousand men separately and watch prefectures one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that in the southeast, beyond the current troop quota, command prefectures should station two thousand men separately and watch prefectures one thousand.

sentences.zh: 帥府置奉錢五百一指揮，以威捷為名；

translations.literal: Command prefectures establish one company at five hundred pay, named Tiger Swift;
translations.idiomatic: Command prefectures were to establish one company at five hundred pay, named Tiger Swift;

sentences.zh: 望郡奉錢四百一指揮，以威勝為名；

translations.literal: watch prefectures one company at four hundred pay, named Tiger Victor;
translations.idiomatic: watch prefectures one company at four hundred pay, named Tiger Victor;

sentences.zh: 帥府三指揮、望郡一指揮各奉錢三百，以全捷為名：並以步軍五百人為額。

translations.literal: command prefectures three companies and watch prefectures one company each at three hundred pay, named All Swift: each with a quota of five hundred foot soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: command prefectures three companies and watch prefectures one company each at three hundred pay, named All Swift—each with a quota of five hundred foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 」三年六月，詔：「國家承平百五十年，東南一方，地大人眾，已見兵寡勢弱，非持久之道。

translations.literal: In year 3, sixth month, an edict said: "The state has enjoyed peace for a hundred and fifty years; the southeast is vast and populous, yet its troops are few and its position weak—not a sustainable course.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 3 an edict observed that the state had been at peace for a hundred and fifty years; the southeast was vast and populous, yet its troops were few and its position weak—not a sustainable course.

sentences.zh: 可除見今兵額外，帥府別屯兵士二千人，望郡一千人。」

translations.literal: Beyond the current troop quota, command prefectures should station two thousand men separately and watch prefectures one thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the current troop quota, command prefectures were to station two thousand men separately and watch prefectures one thousand."

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，詔河北軍馬與陝西、河東更戍。

translations.literal: In Xuanhe 2 an edict ordered Hebei horse and troops to rotate garrison with Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 2 an edict ordered Hebei horse and troops into garrison rotation with Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，詔：「河北軍馬與陝西、河東更戍，非元豐法，遂罷其令。

translations.literal: In year 3, first month, an edict said: "Rotating Hebei horse and troops with Shaanxi and Hedong is not Yuanfeng law; the order is therefore abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3 an edict declared that rotating Hebei horse and troops with Shaanxi and Hedong was not Yuanfeng law, and the order was abolished.

sentences.zh: 應拖後人並與免罪，依舊收管。

translations.literal: Those lagging behind are all exempted from punishment and kept under control as before.
translations.idiomatic: Men who had lagged behind were all exempted from punishment and kept under control as before.

sentences.zh: 」閏五月，江、浙、淮南等路宣撫使童貫奏：「勘會江南東路、兩浙東西路各有東南一將，平日未嘗訓練武藝，臨敵必誤驅策。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, pacification commissioner of Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan circuits Tong Guan memorialized: "Review finds that Jiangnan East Circuit and Liang-Zhe East and West circuits each have one Southeast regiment; on ordinary days they are never trained in martial skill and in battle would surely be mishandled.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month Tong Guan, pacification commissioner of the Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan circuits, memorialized that Jiangnan East and the two Liang-Zhe circuits each held one Southeast regiment that was never trained in ordinary times and would surely be mishandled in battle.

sentences.zh: 昨睦寇初發，天兵未到已前，遣令上項將兵捕賊，遂致敗衄，亡失軍兵甚多。

translations.literal: When the Mu rebels first rose, before imperial troops arrived these regiments were sent to capture bandits, suffered defeat, and lost many soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mu rebels first rose, before imperial troops arrived these regiments were sent against them, suffered defeat, and lost many soldiers.

sentences.zh: 今睦賊討平之後，脅從叛亡者方始還業，非增戍兵鎮遏，無以潛消凶暴。

translations.literal: Now that the Mu rebels have been pacified and coerced followers and fugitives are only just returning to their livelihoods, without increasing garrison troops to suppress them, violence cannot be quietly eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Mu rebels had been pacified and coerced followers and fugitives were only just returning to their livelihoods, without increased garrison troops to hold them down, violence could not be quietly suppressed.

sentences.zh: 臣今擬留戍兵二萬五千五百七十八人，分置江南東路、兩浙東西路州軍防把，一年滿替出軍一次，依平蠻故事，每月別給錢三百，歲給鞋錢一千。

translations.literal: I now propose retaining twenty-five thousand five hundred seventy-eight garrison troops, placing them in defensive garrisons at prefectures and armies of Jiangnan East and Liang-Zhe East and West circuits; one-year terms with one outbound rotation, following the pacifying-the-Yao precedent, with three hundred cash monthly and one thousand shoe money yearly.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed retaining twenty-five thousand five hundred seventy-eight garrison troops in defensive posts across Jiangnan East and the two Liang-Zhe circuits, one-year terms with one outbound rotation, following the pacifying-the-Yao precedent, with three hundred cash monthly and one thousand for shoes yearly.

sentences.zh: 其兵並隸本路安撫司統轄訓練。

translations.literal: These troops are all placed under the circuit pacification commissioner's office for unified command and training.
translations.idiomatic: These troops were all placed under their circuit pacification commissioner's office for unified command and training.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，權知婺州楊應誠奏：「凡屯戍將兵，須隸守臣，使兵民之任歸一，則號令不二，然後可以立事。

translations.literal: That year, acting prefect of Wuzhou Yang Yingcheng memorialized: "All garrison regiment troops must be subordinate to the prefect, so military and civil responsibility rest in one hand; only then are orders undivided and affairs can be accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yang Yingcheng, acting prefect of Wuzhou, memorialized that all garrison regiment troops should be subordinate to the prefect so military and civil responsibility rested in one hand, orders were undivided, and affairs could be accomplished.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 續有旨改從舊制。

translations.literal: Subsequently an imperial order reverted to the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently an imperial order restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 四年，臣僚言：「東軍遠戍四川，皆京師及府界有武藝無過之人。

translations.literal: In year 4 officials said: "East Army troops garrisoning Sichuan from afar are all skilled men without fault from the capital and Capital District.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 officials reported that East Army troops garrisoning Sichuan from afar were all skilled men without fault from the capital and Capital District.

sentences.zh: 既至川路，分屯散處，多不成隊，而差使無時，委致勞弊。

translations.literal: Once in Sichuan they are scattered in garrisons, often failing to form units, and assignments come at any time, truly causing exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Once in Sichuan they were scattered in small garrisons, often failing to form proper units, while assignments came at any time, exhausting them.

sentences.zh: 蓋四川土兵既有詔不得差使，則其役並著東軍，實為偏重。

translations.literal: Because Sichuan local troops are barred by edict from assignments, all duties fall on the East Army—truly a disproportionate burden.
translations.idiomatic: Because Sichuan local troops were barred by edict from assignments, all duties fell on the East Army—a truly disproportionate burden.

sentences.zh: 若令四川應有土兵、禁軍與東軍一同差使，不惟勞逸得均，抑亦不失熙、豐置東軍彈壓蜀人兼備蠻寇之意。

translations.literal: If Sichuan's local troops, Forbidden Army, and East Army shared assignments alike, not only would labor and rest be balanced, but the Xining and Yuanfeng intent of posting East Army to intimidate Shu men while guarding against barbarian raids would not be lost.
translations.idiomatic: If Sichuan's local troops, Forbidden Army, and East Army shared assignments alike, labor and rest would be balanced and the Xining and Yuanfeng intent of posting East Army to intimidate Shu while guarding against barbarian raids would be preserved.

sentences.zh: 」詔本路鈐轄、轉運兩司公同相度利害以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the circuit supervisory and transport commissioners' offices jointly to assess pros and cons and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the circuit supervisory and transport commissioners jointly to assess the matter and report.

sentences.zh: 五年，制置所奏：「江、浙增屯戍兵，相度節鎮增添兩指揮處，餘州各一指揮，各不隸將。

translations.literal: In year 5 the administrative commission reported: "For increased garrison troops in Jiang and Zhe, military-importance prefectures add two companies and other prefectures one each, none subordinate to regiments.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the administrative commission reported that for increased garrison troops in Jiang and Zhe, military-importance prefectures would add two companies and other prefectures one each, none subordinate to regiments.

sentences.zh: 內兩指揮處，將一指揮以威果為名，一指揮以全捷為名，餘州並以威果為名。

translations.literal: Where two companies are added, one is named Valiant Fruit and one All Swift; other prefectures all use Valiant Fruit.
translations.idiomatic: Where two companies were added, one was named Valiant Fruit and one All Swift; other prefectures all used Valiant Fruit.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，詔：「廣南東、西路地遠山險，盜賊間有竊發。

translations.literal: In year 7, third month, an edict said: "Guangnan East and West circuits are remote and mountainous; bandits occasionally arise.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 7 an edict noted that Guangnan East and West circuits were remote and mountainous, and bandits occasionally arose.

sentences.zh: 內郡戍兵往彼屯守，多緣瘴癘疾病，不任捕盜，又不諳知山川道里、林壑曲折，故盜不能禁。

translations.literal: Garrison troops from inner prefectures posted there often fall ill from miasma, cannot capture bandits, and do not know the mountain paths, forests, and winding valleys—so bandits cannot be suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops from inner prefectures posted there often fell to miasma, could not capture bandits, and did not know the mountain paths, forests, and winding valleys—so bandits could not be suppressed.

sentences.zh: 可令每巡檢下招置土人健勇輕捷者，參戍兵之半，互相關防，易於擒捕。

translations.literal: Each patrol inspector may recruit brave, agile local men, half the garrison troop strength, for mutual supervision—easier to capture bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Each patrol inspector was to recruit brave, agile local men equal to half the garrison strength for mutual supervision, making capture easier.

sentences.zh: 令樞密院行之。」

translations.literal: Order the Bureau of Military Affairs to implement it."
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to implement it."

sentences.zh: 七月，河北東路宣撫使李綱奏：「臣兩具論，以七月七日指揮止諸路防秋之兵為不可，必蒙聖察。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Hebei East Route pacification commissioner Li Gang memorialized: "I have twice argued that the order of the seventh day of the seventh month stopping autumn-defense troops on all circuits is wrong—the court must surely have noticed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Li Gang, pacification commissioner of Hebei East Route, memorialized that he had twice argued the seventh-month order stopping autumn-defense troops on all circuits was wrong and trusted the throne had taken note.

sentences.zh: 今宣撫司既無兵可差，不知朝廷既止諸路防秋之兵，將何應副。

translations.literal: The pacification office now has no troops to dispatch; once the court has stopped autumn-defense troops on all circuits, what support is to be provided?"
translations.idiomatic: The pacification office now had no troops to dispatch; once the court had stopped autumn-defense troops on all circuits, what support would be provided?"

sentences.zh: 兼遠方人兵各已在路，又已借請數月，本路漕司、州縣又已預備半年、百日之糧，今一放散，皆成虛費，而實要兵用處無可摘那，深恐誤國大計。

translations.literal: Moreover distant troops are already on the road and months of supplies have been drawn; the circuit transport office and prefectures and counties have already prepared half a year and a hundred days of grain—if all are now dispersed, everything becomes wasted expense, yet where troops are truly needed there is none to redeploy; I deeply fear harming the state's great plan."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover distant troops were already on the road and months of supplies had been drawn; the circuit transport office and prefectures and counties had already prepared half a year and a hundred days of grain—dispersing them now would waste everything, yet where troops were truly needed there were none to redeploy; he deeply feared harming the state's grand strategy."

sentences.zh: 」詔依所奏。

translations.literal: The edict followed his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved as memorialized.

sentences.zh: 紹興之初，群盜四起，有若岳飛、劉光世諸大將領兵尤重，隨宜調發，屯泊要害，控製捍蔽，是亦權宜之利矣。

translations.literal: At the start of Shaoxing, bandits rose on all sides; great generals such as Yue Fei and Liu Guangshi led especially heavy forces, dispatching them flexibly, stationing them at key points to control and shield—these too were expedient advantages.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Shaoxing era bandits rose on all sides; great generals such as Yue Fei and Liu Guangshi led especially heavy forces, dispatched them flexibly, and stationed them at key points to control and shield the realm—expedients that served their purpose.

sentences.zh: 厥後樞府、帥臣屢言久戍之弊，甚者或十年或二十年而不更，尤可閔念。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Bureau and frontier commanders repeatedly spoke of the harms of long garrison; in extreme cases men went ten or twenty years without rotation—especially lamentable.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Bureau and frontier commanders repeatedly warned of the harms of long garrison service; in extreme cases men went ten or twenty years without rotation—a matter especially deserving lament.

sentences.zh: 蓋出戍者皆已老瘁，而諸州所留，類皆少壯及工匠，三司多以坐甲為名，占留違制，有終身未嘗一日戍者，於是命帥臣、鈐轄司置諸州尺籍，定其姓名，依期更戍。

translations.literal: Those on outbound garrison were all aged and exhausted, while what prefectures kept were mostly the young and strong and artisans; the Three Departments often kept men unlawfully under idle-duty rolls—some never garrisoned a single day in their lives. Commanders and supervisory commissioners were therefore ordered to establish roster registers in each prefecture, fix names, and rotate garrison on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Those on outbound garrison were aged and exhausted, while prefectures kept mostly the young and strong and artisans; the Three Departments often unlawfully hoarded men under idle-duty rolls—some never garrisoned a single day in their lives. Commanders and supervisory commissioners were therefore ordered to establish roster registers in each prefecture, fix every name, and rotate garrison on schedule.

sentences.zh: 帥臣又言：「有如貴溪戍兵，三月一更，繇貴溪至池州，往返一千五百里，即是一月在途，徒有勞費。

translations.literal: Frontier commanders also said: "For example, Guixi garrison troops rotate every three months; from Guixi to Chizhou the round trip is fifteen hundred li—effectively one month on the road, nothing but wasted labor and expense.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier commanders also reported that Guixi garrison troops, for example, rotated every three months; from Guixi to Chizhou the round trip was fifteen hundred li—effectively a month on the road, nothing but wasted labor and expense.

sentences.zh: 願以一年終更。」

translations.literal: We wish one full year per rotation."
translations.idiomatic: They asked for one full year per rotation."

sentences.zh: 今考紹興間邊境弗靖，故以大軍屯戍，而踐更之期，近者三月，遠者三年。

translations.literal: Examining the Shaoxing era, the border was unsettled, so large armies were garrisoned; rotation terms ranged from three months nearby to three years distant.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shaoxing era the border was unsettled, so large armies were garrisoned; rotation terms ranged from three months nearby to three years distant.

sentences.zh: 逮和議既成，諸軍移屯者漸歸營矣，惟防秋仍用移屯更戍之法，沿邊備禦亦倚重焉。

translations.literal: Once peace was made, armies on relocation garrison gradually returned to camp; only autumn defense still used the relocation-and-rotation method, on which frontier defense also relied.
translations.idiomatic: Once peace was made, armies on relocation garrison gradually returned to camp; only autumn defense still used relocation and rotation, on which frontier defense also relied.

sentences.zh: 乾道、淳熙、紹熙之際，一遵其制。

translations.literal: During the Qiandao, Chunxi, and Shaoxi reigns, the system was uniformly followed.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qiandao, Chunxi, and Shaoxi reigns the system was uniformly followed.

sentences.zh: 開禧初，復議用兵，駐紮諸兵始復移屯。

translations.literal: Early in Kaixi, when war was again debated, stationed armies once more began relocation garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaixi, when war was again debated, stationed armies once more began relocation garrison.

sentences.zh: 和議再成，邊地一二要郡雖循舊貫，其諸駐紮更戍之法不講，而常屯之兵益多。

translations.literal: When peace was made again, though one or two key frontier prefectures still followed old practice, the rotation methods for stationed troops were neglected and permanently garrisoned troops grew ever more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was made again, though one or two key frontier prefectures still followed old practice, rotation methods for stationed troops were neglected and permanently garrisoned troops grew ever more numerous.

sentences.zh: 逮夫端平破川蜀，咸淳失襄樊、裂淮甸，疆宇蹙而兵法壞。

translations.literal: By Duanping Sichuan was broken, by Xianchun Xiangyang and Fan were lost and the Huai plain split—the realm shrank and military methods collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: By Duanping Sichuan was lost; by Xianchun Xiangyang and Fan fell and the Huai plain was split—the realm shrank and military methods collapsed.

sentences.zh: 叛將賣降，庸夫秉鉞，間有圖國忘死之士，則遙製於權奸，移屯更戍，靡有定方。

translations.literal: Rebel generals sold surrender; mediocrities held command; where men devoted to the state appeared, they were remotely controlled by powerful traitors—relocation and rotation had no fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel generals sold out and surrendered; mediocrities held command; where men who would die for the state appeared, they were controlled from afar by powerful traitors—relocation and rotation had no fixed rule.

sentences.zh: 於是戍卒疲於奔命，不戰而斃者眾矣。

translations.literal: Garrison soldiers were therefore exhausted running to and fro, and many died without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison soldiers were therefore exhausted running to and fro, and many died without ever fighting.

sentences.zh: 至若將校之部曲，諸軍之名號，士卒之眾寡，詳列於屯駐者，茲不重錄云。

translations.literal: As for officers' retinues, army names, and soldier numbers—all detailed in the garrison roster—they are not repeated here.
translations.idiomatic: Officers' retinues, army names, and troop strengths—all detailed in the garrison roster—are not repeated here.
